a: O dilma, bifnim gemiri shehiyyay – la shena lekorban vela shena lemalkut? teku.

Bae rava: tala atzmo baavir azara, mahu? ki gemiri shehiyyay – shehiyyay devat hishtachavaa, delav bat hishtachavaa la gemiri; o dilma, bifnim shehiyyay gemiri – la shena devat hishtachavaa vela shena delav bat hishtachavaa? teku.
Bae rav ashe: timme atzmo bemezid, mahu? beones gemiri shehiyyay, bemezid la gemiri shehiyyay; o dilma, bifnim gemiri shehiyyay – la shena beones vela shena bemezid? teku.
Bae rav ashe: nazir bekever, bae shehiyyay lemalkut o eno tzarich? bifnim gemiri shehiyyay, bachutz la gemiri shehiyyay; o dilma, beones gemiri shehiyyay – la shena bifnim vela shena bachutz? teku.
Ba lo baarukka chayyayv, biktzara patur vechulei. amar rava: ketzara sheamru – afillu akev betzad gudal, vaafillu kol hayyom kullo.
Bae rava: shehiyyot mahu sheyyitztarfu? vetifshot leh middideh! hatam bidla sheha.

Bea minneh abbaye merabba: ba lo baarukka shiur ketzara, mahu? shiur gemiri – vechi ba lo baarukka shiur ketzara patur, o dilma davka gemiri: baarukka – chayyayv, biktzara – patur? amar leh: lo nittena arukka lehiddachot etzlo.
Matkef la rabbi zera, ella dekayyma lan: tame sheshshimmesh – bemita; hechi mashkachat la? i dela sheha – hechi aved avoda? i dishha – bar karet hu!
I amrat bishlama shiura gemiri – mashkachat la deanes nafsheh biktzara veaved avoda.
b: Ella i amrat davka gemiri, hechi mashkachat la?
Amar abbaye: may kusheya? mashkachat la kegon shebba biktzara vehippech betzinnora, vechidrav huna – deamar rav huna: zar shehippech betzinnora, chayyayv mita.
Gufa – amar rav huna: zar shehippech betzinnora, chayyayv mita. hechi dame? i dela happech la la miakkeli – peshita! vei dela happech behu name miakkeli – may ka aved?
La tzericha – dei la happech behu miakkeli betarte shae, vehasheta miakkeli bechad shata; veha ka mashma lan: dechol karove avoda – avoda hi.

Amar rabbi oshaya: baena deema milleta, umistefena mechavrayya. hannichnas levayit hamenugga derech achorav, vaafillu kullo chutz mechotmo – tahor. dichtiv: "vehabba el habbayit" – derech bia asra tora.
Umistefena mechavrayya – i hachi kullo name! amar rava: kullo – la gara mikkelim shebbevayit, dichtiv: "velo yitma kol asher babbayit".

Tanya name hachi: gaggin hallalu – en ochlin sham kodshe kadashim, veen shochatin sham kadashim kallim; vetame shennichnas derech gaggin lahechol – patur, shenneemar: "veel hammikdash lo tavo" – derech bia asra tora.
Zo hi mitzvat ase shebbammikdash sheen chayyayvin aleha vechulei. hecha kae dekaamar "zo hi"? hatam kae – en chayyayvin al ase veal lo taase shebbammikdash,
Veen meviin asham taluy al ase veal lo taase shebbammikdash.
Aval chayyayvin al ase veal lo taase shebbenidda, umeviin asham taluy al ase veal lo taase shebbenidda.

Vekaamar: zo hi mitzvat ase shebbammikdash sheen chayyayvin aleha; veezo hi mitzvat ase shebbenidda shechayyayvin aleha? haya meshammesh im hattehora veamra lo "nitmeti", uferash miyyad – chayyayv, mippene sheyyetziato hanaa lo keviato.
Ittemar, abbaye amar mishshemeh derabbi chiyyay bar rav: chayyayv shetayim. vechen amar rava, amar rav shemuel bar shebba, amar rav huna: chayyayv shetayim, chada akkenisa vachada apperisha.
Have ba rabba: bemay? ilema samuch levistah – uveman? illema betalmid chacham – bishlama akkenisa lichayyayv, kasavar yacholni livol; ella apperisha ammay lichayyayv? mezid hu!

a: Vei beam haaretz – idde veidde "achal shene zete chelev behelem echad" hu!
Veella besheen samuch levistah? uveman? illema betalmid chacham – vela chada la michayyayv; akkenisa – anus, apperisha – mezid! i beam haaretz – chada hu demichayyayv, apperisha!
Hadar amar rava: leolam besamuch levistah, uvetalmid chacham, vetalmid chacham lezo veen talmid chacham lazo.
Amar rava: vetarvayyhu tenanhi; kenisa tenena, perisha tenena. perisha tenena – dekatane: haya meshammesh im hattehora veamra lo "nitmeti", uferash miyyad – chayyayv.
Kenisa tenena: nimtza al shello – temein vechayyayvin bekorban. may, lav besamuch levistah – veakkenisa?

Amar leh rav adda bar matna lerava: leolam ema lach, beshello samuch levivstah – veapperisha; vechi tema: perisha lema li, ha tena leh; ha itzterich leashmoinan: nimtza al shellah – temeim besafek, ufeturin min hakkorban; veayyeyde devae mitne nimtza al shellah, tena name nimtza al shello.

Amar leh ravina lerav adda: mi matzet leokoma lehahi beshello samuch levistah, veapperisha?! veha "nimtza" katane, venimtza" levatar hachi mashma; vei apperisha, meikkara ki paresh leh – meikkara havya leh yedia!
Amar leh rava: tzayet may dekaamar rabbach. hechi etzet? detanya ala: zo hi mitzvat ase shebbenidda shechayyayvin aleha, veim ita – mitzvat lo taase hi!

Amar leh: i taneta – chassar uteni hachi: zo hi mitzvat lo taase shebbenidda shechayyayvin aleha. haya meshammesh im hattehora veamra lo "nitmeti", uferash miyyad – chayyayv, zo hi mitzvat ase shebbenidda kulei.
Amar mar: perash miyyad – chayyayv. hechi aved? amar rav huna mishshemeh derava: noetz eser tzippornav bakkarka ad sheyyamut, vetuveh.
Amar rava: zot omeret, hameshammesh met baarayot – patur. dei salka datach chayyayv, hacha may tama patur? mishshum deanus hu. i anus hu, ki perash miyyad name nippetar – anus hu!

Amar leh abbaye: leolam ema lach, hameshammesh met baarayot chayyayv; vehacha may tama patur – mishshum deanus hu. veha deamrat: ki faresh miyyad ammay chayyayv? shehaya lo lifrosh bahanaa muetet, uferash bahanaa merubba.
Amar leh rabba bar chanan leabbaye: im ken matzinu arukka uketzara benidda,
b: Vaanan bammikdash tenan! ella mishshum dela dame; arukka dehacha – ketzara dehatam, vaarukka dehatam – ketzara dehacha.
Matkef la rav huna bereh derav natan: mi amar abbaye anus hu – alma beshello samuch levistah kaamrinan?! veha abbayye deamar chayyayv shetayim – alma besamuch levistah askinan!
Ki ittemar deabbaye – bealma ittemar.

Bea minneh rabbi yonatan ben yose ben lakonya merabbi shimon ben yose ben lakonya: azhara levoel nidda, minnayin min hattora? shekal kala petak beh: azhara levoel nidda?! "veel ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav"!
Ella azhara limshammesh im hattehora veamra lo "nitmeti", dela nifrosh miyyad – menalan? amar chizkiyya, amar kera: "utehi niddatah alav" – afillu bishat niddatah tehe alav.
Ashkechan ase, lo taase menalan? amar rav pappa, amar kera: "lo tikrav"; "lo tikrav" name la tifrosh hu, dichtiv: "haomrim kerav elecha al tiggash bi ki kedashticha".
Tanu rabbanan: "vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumatam" – amar rabbi yoshiyya: mikkan azhara livne yisrael sheyyifreshu minneshotehen samuch levistan. vechamma? amar rabba: ona.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol sheeno poresh meishto samuch levistah, afillu hoyin lo banim kivne aharon – metim; dichtiv: "vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumatam vehaddava beniddatah", usemich leh: "achare mot".

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol happoresh meishto samuch levistah – hoyin lo banim zecharim, dichtiv: "lehavedil ben hattame uven hattahor", usemich leh: "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar". rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: hoyin lo banim reuyin lehoraa, dichtiv: "lehavedil... ulehorot".

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammavdil al hayyayin bemotzae shabbatot – hoyin lo banim zecharim; dichtiv: "lehavedil ben hakkodesh uven hachol", uchetiv hatam: "lehavedil ben hattame uven hattahor", usemich leh: "ishsha ki tazria". rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: banim reuyin lehoraa, dichtiv: "lehavedil... ulehorot".
Amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet, amar rabbi elazar: kol hamekaddesh et atzmo bishat tashmish – hoyin lo banim zecharim; shenneemar: "vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim", usemich leh: "ishsha ki tazria".
Rabbi eliezer omer: "hashsheretz venelam mimmennu" kulei. may benayyhu?

Amar chizkiyya: sheretz unevela ikka benayyhu – rabbi eliezer savar: baenan ad deyada i besheretz ittammi i binvela ittammi; verabbi akiva savar: la baenan ad deyada, dechevan deyada (deittamma) [deittammi] baolam, la tzerich i besheretz ittammi i binvela ittammi.
Vechen amar ulla: sheretz unevela ikka benayyhu. deulla rame derabbi eliezer adderabbi eliezer, umeshanne – mi amar rabbi eliezer baenan ad deyada i besheretz ittammi i binvela ittammi?!

Vrminhi, amar rabbi eliezer: ma nafshach? chelev achal – chayyayv; notar achal – chayyayv; shabbat chillel – chayyayv; yom hakkippurim chillel – chayyayv; ishto nidda baal – chayyayv; achoto baal – chayyayv!
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua, hare hu omer: "o hoda elav chattato asher chata bah" – ad sheyyivvada lach bamme chata.

Umeshanne: hatam, "asher chata vehevi" amar rachamana – chet kol shehu. hacha, mikkede ketiv "bechol davar tame"; "o benivlat sheretz tame" lema li? shema minna: baenan ad deyada i besheretz ittammi i binvela ittammi.
Verabbi akiva – ayyeyde

a: Devae lemichtav behema vechayya lechidrabbi, katev name sheretz. kidtana deve rabbi yishmael: kol parasha shenneemra venishnet, lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah.
Verabbi eliezer, hay "bah" may aved leh? perat lammitassek.
Verabbi yochanan amar: mashmaut dorshin ikka benayyhu. vechen amar rav sheshet mashmaut dorshin ikka benayyhu – derav sheshet machlef derabbi eliezer lerabbi akiva uderabbi akiva lerabbi eliezer.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: helem ze veze beyado, mahu? amar leh: hare helem tumea beyado, vechayyayv. adderabba – hare helem mikdash beyado, ufatur!

Amar rav ashe: chazenan; i mittumea ka faresh – hare helem tumea beyado, vechayyayv. i mimmikdash ka faresh – hare helem mikdash beyado, ufatur. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: kelum peresh mimmikdash – ella mishshum tumea; kelum peresh mittumea – ella mishshum mikdash! ella la shena.
Tanu rabbanan: shene shevilin, echad tame veechad tahor; vehalach barishon velo nichnas, bashsheni venichnas – chayyayv.
Halach barishon venichnas, hizza veshana vetaval, veachar kach halach bashsheni venichnas – chayyayv. rabbi shimon poter. verabbi shimon ben yehuda poter bechullan mishshum rabbi shimon.
Bechullan –
b: Vaafillu bekammayyta?! mimma nafshach tame hu! amar rava: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehalach barishon, uveshaa shehalach bashsheni shachach shehalach barishon; dehavya leh miktzat yedia.
Uveha ka mippalgi – tanna kamma savar: amrinan miktzat yedia kechol yedia; verabbi shimon savar: la amrinan miktzat yedia kechol yedia.
Halach barishon venichnas, hizza veshana vetaval, chazar vehalach bashsheni venichnas – chayyayv, verabbi shimon poter. veammay chayyayv? sefek yedia hu!
Amar rabbi yochanan: kan asu sefek yedia kidia. veresh lakish amar: ha manni – rabbi yishmael hi, deamar: la baenan yedia battechilla.

Uremi derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan, uremi deresh lakish adderesh lakish. detanya: achal sefek chelev venoda, sefek chelev venoda – rabbi omer: keshem shemmevi chattat al kol echad veechad, kach mevi asham taluy al kol echad veechad.

Rabbi shimon ben yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon amru mishshum rabbi shimon: eno mevi ella asham taluy echad, shenneemar: "al shiggato asher shagag" – hattora ribbeta shegagot harebe veasham taluy echad.
Veamar resh lakish: kan shana rabbi, yediot sefekot mitchallekot lechattaot.
Verabbi yochanan amar: keshem sheyyediot vadday bealma mitchallekot lechattaot, kach yediot safek mitchallekot laashamot.

Bishlama derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan la kashya – kan asu, velo bechol hattora kullah asu. hacha hu dela ketiva yedia behedya, mivvenelam" hu deka ate; velo bechol hattora kullah asu, dichtiv: "o hoda elav" – yedia meallayyta baenan.
Ella leresh lakish – addemokem leh kerabbi yishmael, nokma kerabbi! ha ka mashma lan – derabbi yishmael la bae yedia battechilla.
Peshita dela bae – middela meyaytri leh kerae; "venelam" – demichayyayv al helem mikdash! mahu detema: ki let leh – mikkerae, aval miggemara it leh; ka mashma lan.
Hadaran alach yediot hattumea
Mishna shevuot shetayim shehen arba: "shevua sheochal" veshello ochal", "sheachalti" veshello achalti".

"Shevua shello ochal", veachal kol shehu – chayyayv. divre rabbi akiva. amru lo lerabbi akiva: hechan matzinu beochel kol shehu shehu chayyayv – shezze chayyayv? amar lahem rabbi akiva: vechi hechan matzinu bimdabber umevi korban – shezze medabber umevi korban?
Gemara lememra desheochal" – deachelna mashma?! ureminhi: "shevua lo ochal lach", "shevua sheochal lach", "lo shevua shello ochal lach" – asur.
Amar abbaye: leolam deachelna mashma; la kashya, kan bimsarvin bo leechol, kan besheen

a: Mesarvin bo leechol.
Matnitin – besheen mesarvin bo leechol; barayyta – bimsarvin bo leechol, vekaamar "la achelna" vela achelna", dechi ka mishteva hachi kaamar: "shevua shello ochal".
Rav ashe amar: teni "shevua shei ochal lach". i hachi, may lememra? mahu detema: lishshaneh (daaytekaylaa) [ittekilo] leh, ka mashma lan.
Tanu rabbanan: "mivta" – shevua. "issar" – shevua. issur issar: im atta omer "issar" – shevua, chayyayv; veim lav, patur. "im atta omer issar shevua"?! veha amrat: issar – shevua hu!
Amar abbaye: hachi kaamar, "mivta" – shevua. "issar" – mittefes bishvua. issur issar – im atta omer: mittefes bishvua kemotzi shevua mippiv dame, chayyayv; veim lav, patur.
Mimmay demivta shevua – dichtiv: "o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim"; issar name – dichtiv: "kol neder vechol shevuat issar";
Ella mimmay deissar mittefes bishvua hu? dichtiv: "o asra issar al nafshah bishvua".
Mevatte name – hachtiv: "lechol asher yevatte haadam bishvua"!
Ella amar abbaye: mivta shevua mehacha: "veim hayo tihye leish unedareha aleha, o mivta sefateha asher asra al nafshah" – veillu shevua la kaamar; bemay asra atzmah? bemivta.

Rava amar: leolam ema lach, mittefes bishvua lav kemotzi shevua mippiv dame; vehachi kaamar: "mivta" – shevua. "issar" – name shevua. issareh deissar – hittilo hakkatuv ben neder lishvua; hotzio bilshon neder – neder, bilshon shevua – shevua.
Hechan hittilo? "veim bet ishah nadara o asra issar al nafshah bishvua vegomer"
Veazdu letamayyhu; deittemar: matpis bishvua – abbaye amar: kemotzi shevua mippiv dame, verava amar: lav kemotzi shevua mippiv dame.

Metivi: eze issar haamur battora? haomer: "hare alay shello ochal basar veshello eshte yayin" kayyom shemmet bo aviv, kayyom shemmet bo peloni, keyom shenneherag bo gedalya ben achikam, kayyom sheraa yerushalayim bechurebanah – asur. veamar shemuel: vehu shennadur uva meoto hayyom.
Bishlama leabbaye, middematpis beneder – neder, matpis bishvua – shevua.
b: Ella lerava kashya!

Amar lach rava, taretz veema hachi: ezehu issar neder haamur battora? haomer: "hare alay shello ochal basar veshello eshte yayin" kayyom shemmet bo aviv, kayyom shenneherag bo peloni. veamar shemuel: vehu shennadur uva meoto hayyom.
May tama? amar kera: "ish ki yiddor neder laAdonai" – ad sheyyiddor bedavar hannadur.

Kayyom shemmet bo aviv. peshita! keyom shenneherag bo gedalya ben achikam itzterich leh, salka datach amena: kevan dechi la nadar name asur – ki nadar name la havya aleh issur, vehay lav mittefes beneder hu; ka mashma lan.
Veaf rabbi yochanan savar la leha derava; dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: "mivta lo ochal lach", "issar lo ochal lach" – shevua.

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: "ochal" velo ochal" – sheker, veazharteh mehacha: "la tishshavu vishmi lashshaker". "achalti" velo achalti" – shav, veazharteh mehacha: "lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav".
Kunnamot – over belo yachel devaro".
Metivi: shav vesheker echad hen. may, lav middeshav lesheavar – af sheker name lesheavar? alma "achalti" velo achalti" sheker hu!

Midde irya?! ha kidita, veha kidita. umay "davar echad hen"? divdibbur echad neemru, kidtanya: "zachor" veshamor" bedibbur echad neemru – ma sheen yachol happe ledabber, uma sheen haozen yachol lishmoa.

Bishlama hatam bedibbur echad neemru, kidrav adda bar ahava – deamar rav adda bar ahava: nashim chayyayvot bekiddush hayyom devar tora, deamar kera "zachor" veshamor" – kol sheyyeshno bishmira yeshno bizchira, vehane neshe hoil veitanhu bishmira itanhu name bizchira. ella hacha lemay hilcheta mibbee leh?
Ella keshem shelloke al shav, kach loke name al sheker.
Kelappe leyay? ella ema: keshem shelloke al sheker, kach loke name al shav.
Peshita – hay lav vehay lav! mahu detema kedaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye: "lo yinnake" kelal;

a: Ka mashma lan kidshanni leh.
Veibbaet ema: keshem shemmevi korban al sheker, kach mevi korban al shav; verabbi akiva hi, dimchayyev lesheavar kilhabba.
Metivi: e zo hi shevuat shav – nishba leshannot et hayyadua leadam. shevuat sheker – nishba lehachelif! ema nishba umachlif.

Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yirmeya, amar rabbi avahu, amar rabbi yochanan: "achalti" velo achalti" – sheker, veazharteh millo tishshavu vishmi lashshaker". "ochal" velo ochal" – over belo yachel devaro". vee zo hi shevuat shav? nishba leshannot et hayyadua leadam.

Amar rav pappa: ha derabbi avahu – lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar; deamar rav idi bar avin: amar rav amram, amar rav yitzchak, amar rabbi yochanan, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili: kol lo taase shebbattora – lav sheyyesh bo maase lokin alav, vesheen bo maase en lokin alav; chutz minnishba umemer umekallel et chavero bashshem.

Nishba menalan? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay, amar kera: "lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav ki lo yenakke" – bet din shel mala en menakkin oto, aval bet din shel matta malkin oto umenakkin oto.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: dilma hachi kaamar rachamana: "lo yenakke" kelal? i ketiv "ki lo yenakke" – kidkaamrat; hasheta dichtiv "ki lo yenakke Adonai" – Adonai hu deeno menakke, aval bet din shel matta malkin oto umenakkin oto.
Ashkechan shevuat shav, shevuat sheker menalan? rabbi yochanan dideh amar: "lashshav" "lashshav" shete peamim; im eno inyan lishvuat shav, tenehu inyan lishvuat sheker.

Vehave ba rabbi avahu: hay shevuat sheker hechi dame? illema "shevua shello ochal", veachal – lav sheyyesh bo maase hu! veella deamar "shevua sheochal", velo achal – hay mi loke?! veha ittemar: "shevua sheochal kikkar zo hayyom", veavar hayyom velo achalah – rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: eno loke!

Rabbi yochanan amar eno loke – mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav. veresh lakish amar eno loke – mishshum dehave hateraat safek, vehateraat safek lo shemah hateraa.
Veamar rabbi avahu: tehe beachalti" velo achalti". umay shena? amar rava: beferush ribbeta tora shevuat sheker doma leshav, ma shav lesheavar, af sheker name lesheavar.

Etiveh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi avahu: "shevua shello ochal kikkar zo", "shevua shello ochlenna", "shevua shello ochlenna", vaachalah – eno chayyayv ella achat. zo hi shevuat bittuy, shechayyayvin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah korban ole veyored.
Zo hi – lemaote may? lav lemaote "achalti" velo achalti" – dela lake?

La, lemaote "achalti" velo achalti" mikkorban – zo hi deal shiggatah korban ole veyored, aval "achalti" velo achalti" la. verabbi yishmael hi, deamar: eno chayyayv ella al heatid lavo; aval milka lake.
b: Ema sefa: zo hi shevuat shav shechayyayvin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah patur. zo hi lemaote may? may lav lemaote "achalti" velo achalti" – dela lake?
La; zo hi deal shiggatah patur mikkorban, aval "achalti" velo achalti" al shiggatah chayyayv korban; verabbi akiva hi, dimchayyev lesheavar kilhabba.

Ha amrat resha rabbi yishmael hi! resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva?! kulla rabbi akiva, veresha lav lemaote "achalti" velo achalti" mikkorban, ella lemaote "ochal" velo achal mimmalkot, aval korban michayyayv.
Umay shena? mistabbera, kae bilhabba – memaet lehabba; kae bilhabba – memaet lesheavar?

"Shevua shello ochal" veachal kol shehu, chayyayv kulei. ibbaya lehu: rabbi akiva, bechol hattora kullah – kerabbi shimon sevira leh, dimchayyev bemashshehu? detanya, rabbi shimon omer: kol shehu lemakkot, velo amru kezayit ella leinyan korban.
Uvedin hu devae ippeloge bealma, vehay deka mippalgi hacha – lehodiacha kochan derabbanan, deaf al gav deikka lememar: hoil umefaresh chayyayv, setam name chayyayv; ka mashma lan defatri.
O dilma, bealma – kerabbanan sevira leh; vehacha hayeynu tama – hoil umefaresh chayyayv, setam name chayyayv.
Ta shema, deamru lo lerabbi akiva: hechan matzinu beochel kol shehu chayyayv, shezze chayyayv? veim ita, lema lehu: ana bechol hattora kullah kerabbi shimon sevira li!
Ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu: ledidi, bechol hattora kullah kerabbi shimon sevira li. ledidchu, odo li miha, hoil umefaresh chayyayv, setam name chayyayv! vaamaru leh rabbanan: la.
Ta shema, rabbi akiva omer: nazir sheshshara pitto beyayin, veyesh bah kede letzaref kezayit – chayyayv. vei salka datach bealma kerabbi shimon sevira leh, lema li letzaref?

Veod tenan: "shevua shello ochal", veachal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim – chayyayv. verabbi shimon poter. vehavenan ba: ammay chayyayv? musheba mehar sinay hu! rav ushemuel verabbi yochanan deamri tarvayyhu: becholel devarim hammuttarin im devarim haasurin.
Veresh lakish amar: i atta motze ella i bimfaresh chatzi shiur – veallibba derabbanan, i bistam – veallibba derabbi akiva deamar: adam oser atzmo bechol shehu.
Vei salka datach bealma kerabbi shimon sevira leh, kol shehu name musheba veomed mehar sinay hu! ella lav shema minna: bealma kerabbanan sevira leh? shema minna.
Amru lo lerabbi akiva: hechan matzinu kulei. vela?! vahare nemala! beriyya shane.
Vahare hekdesh! ha baenan shave peruta.
Vahare mefaresh! mefaresh name kivriyya dame.
Vahare afar! ella

a: Tifshot devae rava: "shevua shello ochal" veachal afar, bechamma? tifshot ad deikka kezayit! ki kaamrinan – bemidde devar achila kaamrinan.
Vahare kunnamot! kunnamot name kimfaresh dame.
Amar lahen: hechan matzinu bimdabber umevi korban, shezze medabber umevi korban. vela?! vahare megaddef! medabber veoser kaamrinan, vehay medabber vechote hu.
Vahare nazir! mevi korbano al dibburo kaamrinan, vehay mevi korban – leishteroye leh chamra hu deka mayyte.
Vahare hekdesh! oser leatzmo kaamrinan, vehay oser al kol haolam kullo hu.
Hare kunnamot! kasavar en meila bekunnamot.
Amar rava: machaloket bistam, aval bimfaresh – divre hakkol bechol shehu. may tama? mefaresh name kivriyya dame.
Veamar rava: machloket beshello ochal", aval beshello etom" – divre hakkol bechol shehu. peshita! mahu detema: litom name – kidamri inashe; ka mashma lan.
Amar rav pappa: machloket bishvuot, aval bekunnamot – divre hakkol bechol shehu. may tama? kunnamot name, kevan dela ka madkar shema daachila, kedimfaresh dame.
Metivi: shene kunnamot mitztarfin, shete shevuot en mitztarfot. rabbi meir omer: kunnamot kishvuot. vei salka datach chayyayv bechol shehu, lema li letzaref?
Deamar: "achila mizzo alay kunnam", "achila mizzo alay kunnam". i hachi, ammay mitztarfot? sof sof – zil lehacha lekka shiura, vezil lehacha lekka shiura! deamar: "achila mishshetehen alay kunnam".
Dichvavta gabbe shevuot – deamar: "shevua shello ochal mishshetehen", ammay en mitztarfin? amar rav pinchas: shane shevuot, mittoch shechalukot lechattaot, en mitztarfot.
I hachi, rabbi meir omer: kunnamot kishvuot – bishlama shevuot, hoil vachalukot lechattaot; ella kunnamot, ammay la? efoch – rabbi meir omer: shevuot kekunnamot. velet leh lidrav pinchas.
Ravina amar: ki kaamar rav pappa – leinyan malkot; ki tanya hahi – leinyan korban, devaenan shave peruta.

Lememra desavri rabbanan yesh meila bekunnamot?! vehatanya: "kikkar zo hekdesh", vaachalah – ben hu ben chavero maal; lefichach yesh lah pidyon. "kikkar zo alay hekdesh" – hare hu maal, chavero lo maal; lefichach en lah pidyon. divre rabbi meir.
b: Vachachamim omrim: ben hu uven chavero lo maal, lefi sheen meila bekunnamot.
Efoch: echad ze veechad ze lo maal, lefi sheen meila bekunnamot. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: hu maal, vachavero lo maal.
I hachi, rabbi meir omer kunnamot kishvuot – ella kunnamot itzterofe hu dela mitztarfi, ha meila it behu?! vehaamar rabbi meir: en meila bekunnamot kelal!
Ledivrehen derabbanan kaamar lehu: ledidi – en meila bekunnamot kelal; ledidchu – odo li mihat dekunnamot kishvuot!
Verabbanan – shevuot ikka derav pinchas, kunnamot lekka derav pinchas.

Amar rava: "shevua shello ochal", veachal afar – patur. bae rava: "shevua shello ochal afar", bechamma? kevan deamar "shello ochal" – dateh akkezayit; o dilma, kevan delav midde deachli inashe hu, bechol shehu? teku.
Bae rava: "shevua shello ochal chartzan", bechamma? kevan demitachil al yede taarovet – dateh akkezayit; o dilma, kevan dela beeneh achli leh inashe – dateh ammashshehu? teku.

Bae rav ashe: nazir sheamar "shevua shello ochal chartzan", bechamma? dechevan dichzayit issura deorayyta hu, ki ka mishteva – ahettera ka mishteva, vedateh ammashshehu; o dilma, kevan deamar "shello ochal", dateh akkezayit?

Ta shema: "shevua shello ochal", veachal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim – chayyayv. verabbi shimon poter. vehavenan ba: ammay chayyayv? musheba veomed mehar sinay hu! rav ushemuel verabbi yochanan deamri: becholel devarim hammuttarin im devarim haasurin.
Veresh lakish amar: i atta motze ella i bimfaresh chatzi shiur, veallibba derabbanan; i bistam, veallibba derabbi akiva deamar: adam oser atzmo bechol shehu.
Veha nevela – demusheba veomed mehar sinay hu, dechi chartzan legabbe nazir damya; vetama defaresh, ha la paresh – dateh akkezayit! shema minna.
Ella tifshot devae rava: "shevua shello ochal afar", bechamma? tifshot dead deikka kezayit – deha nevela keafar damya; vetama defaresh, ha lo parish – dateh akkezayit!
Lo; afar – lav bar achila hu kelal; nevela – bat achila, vearya hu dirvia illavav.

Mishna "shevua shello ochal", veachal veshata – eno chayyayv ella achat. "shevua shello ochal veshello eshte", veachal veshata – chayyayv shetayim. "shevua shello ochal", veachal pat chittin ufat seorin ufat kussemin – eno chayyayv ella achat. "shevua shello ochal pat chittin ufat seorin ufat kussemin", veachal – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. "shevua shello eshte", veshata mashkin harebe – eno chayyayv ella achat. "shevua shello eshte yayin veshemen udevash", veshata – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.

"Shevua shello ochal", veachal ovchalin sheenan reuyin laachila, veshata mashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya – patur. "shevua shello ochal", veachal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim – chayyayv. verabbi shimon poter. amar: "kunnam ishti nehenet li im achalti hayyom", vehu achal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim – hare ishto asura.
Gemara amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar shemuel: "shevua shello ochal", veshata – chayyayv. ibbaet ema sevara, veibbaet ema kera.

Ibbaet ema sevara – daamar leh inash lechavreh: "nitom midde", veayyli veachli veshatu. veibbaet ema kera – shetiyya bichlal achila; deamar resh lakish: minnayin lishtiyya shehi bichlal achila? shenneemar: "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha bammakom asher yivchar leshakken shemo sham masar degancha vetiroshcha";

a: Vetirosh chamra hu, uchetiv: "veachalta".
Vedilma al yede anigron? deamar rabba bar shemuel: anigron – mayya desilke, akkesigron – mayya dechullehu silki.
Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov, mehacha: "venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha, babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar"; yayin chamra hu, uchetiv: "veachalta".
Vedilma hacha name al yede anigron?
"Shechar" ketiv, midde dimshakkar.
Vedilma devela keilit? detanya: achal devela keilit veshata devash vechalav, venichnas lammikdash veavad – chayyayv.
Ella gamar "shechar"–"shechar" minnazir; ma lehallan yayin, af kan yayin.

Amar rava, af anan name tenena: "shevua shello ochal", veachal veshata – eno chayyayv ella achat. i amrat bishlama shetiyya bichlal achila, itzterich leh letanna leashmoinan deeno chayyayv ella achat. ella i amrat shetiyya lav bichlal achila, "shevua shello ochal", veachal veasa melacha – mi itzterich leashmoinan deeno chayyayv ella achat?!

Amar leh abbaye: ella may, shetiyya bichlal achila?! ema sefa: "shevua shello ochal veshello eshte", veachal veshata – chayyayv shetayim. kevan deamar "shello ochal" – ittesar leh bishtiyya; ki amar "shello eshte" – ammay chayyayv? illu amar "shello eshte" tere zimne, mi michayyayv tarte?!
Amar leh: hatam deamar "shello eshte", vahadar amar "shello ochal"; dishtiyya bichlal achila ita, achila bichlal shetiyya leta.

Aval amar shevua "shello ochal veshello eshte", veachal veshata, may – eno chayyayv ella achat? i hachi, addetane resha: "shevua shello ochal" veachal veshata eno chayyayv ella achat; litne: "shevua shello ochal veshello eshte" eno chayyayv ella achat – vechol shekken "shello ochal" lechodeh!
Ella leolam kidkatane; veshane hacha, kevan deamar "shello ochal" vahadar amar "shello eshte" – galli addateh dehach achila deamar, achila geredta hi.

Amar rav ashe, matnitin name dayka: "shevua shello ochal", veachal ovchalin sheen reuyin laachila, veshata mashkin sheen reuyin lishtiyya – patur. ha reuyin – chayyayv; veammay? ha "shevua shello ochal" kaamar!
Dilma deamar tarte: "shevua shello ochal", "shevua shello eshte".
Shevua shello ochal, veachal pat chittin kulei. vedilma lemiftar nafsheh meachranyayta kaate?
Hava leh lememar "chittin useorin vechussemin". vedilma lachos?
Dahava leh lememar "pat chittin useorin vechussemin". vedilma "pat chittin" – leechol, "seorin vechussemin" – lachos?
Dahava leh lememar "pat chittin veshel seorin veshel kussemin".
b: Vedilma al yede taarovet?
Ema "vechen shel seorim vechen shel kussemin"; "pat" "pat" lema li? shema minna lechallek.

"Shevua shello eshte" veshata mashkin harebe, eno chayyayv ella achat kulei. bishlama hatam, deamrat meyaytra leh "pat" "pat" lechiyyuva; ella hacha, may hava lememar? dilma lemiftar nafsheh mimmashkin acharine kaate!
Amar rav pappa: hacha bemunnachin lefanav askinan, shehaya lo lomar "shevua shello eshte ellu". vedilma ellu hu dela shatena, acharine shatena?
Ella deamar "shevua dela shatena kegon ellu". dilma kegon ellu dela shatena; betzir mehachi utefe mehachi shatena?
Ella kegon deamar: "shevua shello eshte mimmin ellu". vedilma min ellu hu dela shatena, ha inhu gufayyhu shatena?
Ema "shello eshte ellu uminnayyhu".

Rav acha bereh derav ika amar: bimsarhev bo chavero askinan, deamar lo: "bo ushete immi yayin veshemen udevash". dehaya lo lomar: "shevua shello eshte immecha", "yayin veshemen udevash" lema li? lechayyev al kol achat veachat.

Tenan hatam: "ten li chittin useorin vechussemin sheyyesh li beyadcha", "shevua sheen lecha beyadi kelum" – eno chayyayv ella achat. "shevua sheen lecha beyadi chittin useorin vechussemin" – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: afillu peruta mikkullam mitztarefet.
Peligi ba rav acha veravina; chad amar: apperate michayyayv, akkelale la michayyayv; vechad amar: akkelale name michayyayv.
Hacha may?

Amar rava: hachi hasheta?! hatam michayyayv akkelala umichayyayv apperata, deha i mishteva vahadar mishteva – michayyayv tarte. hacha, i salka datach ita bichlala, apperate ammay michayyayv? musheba veomed hu!

Shevua shello ochal vechulei. ha gufa kashya – amrat: "shevua shello ochal", veachal ovchalin sheen reuyin laachila veshata mashkin sheen reuyin lishtiyya – patur; vahadar tane: "shevua shello ochal", veachal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim – chayyayv; may shena resha defatur, umay shena sefa dechayyayv?
Ha la kashya; resha bistam, vesefa bimfaresh.
Mefaresh name gufeh tikshe – ammay musheba mehar sinay hu?
Rav ushemuel verabbi yochanan deamri: becholel devarim hammuttarin im devarim haasurin.
Veresh lakish amar: i atta motze ella i bimfaresh chatzi shiur – veallibba derabbanan; i bistam – allibba derabbi akiva, deamar: adam oser atzmo bechol shehu.
Bishlama rabbi yochanan la amar keresh lakish – demokem lah lematnitin kedivre hakkol; ella resh lakish, may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan?
Amar lecha: ki amrinan issur kolel –

a: Beissur habba meelav; beissur habba al yede atzmo la amrinan.
Bishlama leresh lakish, mishshum hachi ka fatar rabbi shimon; detanya, rabbi shimon omer: kol shehu lemakkot, velo amru kezayit ella lekorban. ella lerabbi yochanan, may tama derabbi shimon defatar?
Midde hu tama – ella mishshum issur kolel; rabbi shimon letameh delet leh issur kolel. detanya, rabbi shimon omer: haochel nevela beyom hakkippurim – patur.
Bishlama leresh lakish, mashkachat la belav vahen; ella lerabbi yochanan, bishlama lav – mashkachat la, ella hen – hechi mashkachat la?
Ella kidrava, deamar rava: "shevua shello ochal", veachal afar – patur.
Amar rav mari, af anan name tenena: "kunnam ishti nehenet li im achalti hayyom", veachal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim – hare ishto asura lo.
Hachi hasheta?! hatam, kevan demeikkara (achal) [achleh] vahadar ishteva (leh) [aleh],
b: (Chashevabey) [achshove]; ella hacha mi achsheveh?!
Amar rava: may tama deman deit leh issur kolel?
Midde dehave aissur mosif.
Uman defatar, delet leh? ki amar issur mosif – bachada chaticha, bishte chatichot la amrinan.
Veamar rava: leman deit leh issur kolel, amar "shevua shello ochal teenim", vechazar veamar "shevua shello ochal teenim vaanavim" – miggo dechayyla shevua aanavim, chayyla name atteenim.
Peshita!
Mahu detema: issur habba meelav amrinan, issur habba meatzmo la amrinan; ka mashma lan.
Metiv rava bereh derabba: yesh ochel achila achat, vechayyayv aleha arba chattaot veasham echad; veellu hen: tame sheachal chelev, vehu notar, min hammukedashin, beyom hakkippurim.
Rabbi meir omer: af im hayta shabbat vehotzio – chayyayv. amru lo: eno min hashshem.
Veim ita, mashkachat la chamesh – kegon sheamar "shevua shello ochal temarim vechelev", miggo dechayyla shevua attemarim, chayyla name achelev!
Ki katane, issur habba meelav; issur habba meatzmo la katane.
Vahare hekdesh!
Bivchor, dikdushshato merechem.
Ibbaet ema: ki katane, midde delet leh sheela; shevua deit leh sheela la katane.
Hare hekdesh!
Ha okminan bivchor.
Ibbaet ema: ki katane, korban kavua; korban ole veyored la katane.
Hare tame sheachal et hakkodesh – dekorban ole veyored hu!
Benasi, verabbi eliezer hi deamar: nasi mevi sair.
Rav ashe amar: ki katane, midde devae shiur; shevua dechayyla appachot mikkeshiur, la katane.
Hare hekdesh!
Ha baenan shave peruta.
Verav ashe meavverya amar rabbi zera: ki katane, zedono karet; zedono lav, la katane.
Vahare asham, dizdono lav, vekatane!

a: Bechattat kaamrinan.
Ravina amar: ki katane, midde dechayel ammidde devar achila hu; shevua dechayyla ammidde delav bar achila hu, la katane.
Vahare hekdesh – dechayel name aetzim vaavanim!
Ella ki katane, midde dechayel ammidde deit be meshasha; shevua dechayyla ammidde delet beh meshasha, kegon "sheishan" veshello ishan" – la katane.
Mishna echad devarim shel atzmo veechad devarim shel acherim, veechad devarim sheyyesh bahen mammash veechad devarim sheen bahen mammash.
Ketzad? amar "shevua sheetten leish peloni" veshello etten"; "shennatatti" veshello natatti";
"Sheishan" veshello ishan"; "sheyyashanti" veshello yashanti"; "sheezrok tzeror layyam" veshello ezrok"; "shezzarakti" veshello zarakti".
Rabbi yishmael omer: eno chayyayv ella al heatid lavo, shenneemar: "lehara o lehetiv".
Amar lo rabbi akiva: im ken, en li ella devarim sheyyesh bahen haraa vahatava; devarim sheen bahen haraa vahatava minnayin?
Amar lo: meribbuy hakkatuv. amar lo: im ribba hakkatuv lechach, ribba hakkatuv lechach!
Gemara tanu rabbanan: chomer bannedarim mibbashshevuot, chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim. chomer bannedarim – shehannedarim chalim al devar mitzva kidvar harshut, ma sheen ken bashshevuot.
Chomer bashshevuot – shehashshevuot chalot al davar sheen bo mammash kedavar sheyyesh bo mammash, ma sheen ken bannedarim.
Ketzad? amar "shevua sheetten lifloni" veshello etten". may "etten"? illema tzedaka leani, musheba veomed mehar sinay hu – shenneemar: "naton titten lo"!
Ella mattana leashir.
"Sheishan" veshello ishan" – ini?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: haomer "shevua shello ishan shelosha yamim" – malkin oto veyashen lealtar!
Hatam deamar "shelosha", hacha dela amar "shelosha".
"Sheezrok tzeror layyam" veshello ezrok". ittemar: "shevua shezzarak peloni tzeror layyam" veshello zarak", rav amar chayyayv, ushemuel amar patur.
Rav amar chayyayv – iteh belav vehen. ushemuel amar patur – leteh bilhabba.

Lema biflugeta derabbi yishmael verabbi akiva ka mippalgi? ditnan, rabbi yishmael omer: eno chayyayv ella al heatid lavo, shenneemar: "lehara o lehetiv". amar lo rabbi akiva: im ken, en li ella devarim sheyyesh bahen haraa vahatava, devarim sheen bahen haraa vahatava minnayin?
Amar lo: meribbuy hakkatuv. amar lo: im ribba hakkatuv lechach, ribba hakkatuv lechach!
Rav deamar kerabbi akiva, ushemuel deamar kerabbi yishmael?
Allibba derabbi yishmael – kulle alma la peligi; hasheta milleta deita bilhabba la mechayyayv ala rabbi yishmael lesheavar, milleta deleta bilhabba mibbaya?!

Ki peligi – allibba derabbi akiva. rav – kerabbi akiva; ushemuel amar: ad kan la mechayyev rabbi akiva hatam lesheavar, ella milleta deita bilhabba – mechayyev rabbi akiva lesheavar; aval midde deleteh bilhabba – la.
Lema biflugeta
b: Derabbi yehuda ben betera verabbanan kamippalgi? ditnan: nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bittel – patur. lekayyem et hammitzva velo kiyyem – patur. shehaya baddin sheyyehe chayyayv, kedivre rabbi yehuda ben betira; deamar rabbi yehuda ben betira: uma im harshut, sheeno musheba aleha mehar sinay – hare hu chayyayv aleha; mitzva, shemmusheba aleha mehar sinay – eno din sheyyehe chayyayv aleha?
Amru lo: lo; im amarta bishvuat harshut – shekken asa bah lav kehen; tomar bishvuat mitzva – shekken lo asa bah lav kehen?!
Nema rav deamar kerabbi yehuda ben betira, ushemuel deamar kerabbanan?
Allibba derabbi yehuda ben betira – kulle alma la peligi; hasheta lav vahen la bae, lehabba ulesheavar bae?!

Ki peligi – allibba derabbanan. shemuel – kerabbanan; verav – ki la mechayyeyvi rabbanan belav vahen, dichtiv "lehara o lehetiv" behedya; aval lehabba ulesheavar, demeribbuya dikrae atu – mechayyeyvi.

Metiv rav hamenuna: "lo achalti hayyom" velo hinnachti tefillin hayyom"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – chayyayv. bishlama "lo achalti" – iteh belo ochal"; ella "lo hinnachti" – mi iteh belo anniach"?!
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la – litzdadin katane: "lo achalti" – lekorban, "lo hinnachti" – lemalkot.

Metiv rava: ezo hi shevuat shav? nishba leshannot et hayyadua laadam – veamar al ammud shel even shehu bemakom peloni, shehu shel zahav. veamar ulla: vehu shennikkar lishlosha bene adam. tama denikkar; ha lo nikkar – over mishshum shevuat bittuy. veammay? ha eno bihe shel zahav"!
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la: nikkar – over mishshum shevuat shav, lo nikkar – over mishshum shevuat sheker.
Amar abbaye: umode rav beomer lachavero "shevua sheani yodea lecha edut", veishtechach dela yeda leh – defatur, hoil veleteh bichlal "sheeni yodea lecha edut".
"Yadati" velo yadati" – machloket. "headti" velo headti" – machloket.
Bishlama lishmuel, deamar: milleta deleteh bilhabba la mechayyev aleh lesheavar; lehachi appeka rachamana lishvuat edut mikkelal shevuat bittuy. ella lerav, lemay hilcheta appeka rachamana?
Amruha rabbanan kammeh deabbaye: leichayyove alay tarte.
Amar lehu: tarte la matzitu amritu, detanya: leachat meelle – leachat atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo shetayim!
Uleabbaye, lemay hilcheta appekay rachamana?
Lechidtanya: bechullan neemar "veneelam", vechan lo neemar "venelam"; lechayyev al hammezid kashshogeg.
Amaru leh rabbanan leabbaye: ema bemezid michayyayv chada, beshogeg michayyayv tarte!
Amar lehu: lav hayeynu daamari – "leachat", achat atta mechayyeyvo vei atta mechayyeyvo shetayim; vei bemezid, mi ikka tarte?
Rava amar: mishshum dehave davar shebbakkelal veyatza liddon bedavar hechadash – en lecha bo ella chiddusho bilvad.
Mikkelal deabbaye savar: ita lishvua baolam?!
Vehaamar abbaye: mode rav beomer lachavero "shevua sheani yodea lach edut", veishtechach dela yeda leh – defatur, hoil veleteh beeni yodea lach edut!
Hadar beh abbaye mehahi. veibbaet ema:

a: Chada minnayyhu rav pappa amra.

Rabbi yishmael omer: eno chayyayv ella al heatid lavo. tanu rabbanan: "lehara o lehetiv" – en li ella devarim sheyyesh bahen haraa vahatava; sheen bahen haraa vahatava minnayin? talmud lomar: "o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim".
En li ella lehabba, lesheavar minnayin? talmud lomar: "lechol asher yevatte haadam bishvua". divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer: "lehara o lehetiv" – lehabba.

Amar lo rabbi akiva: im ken, en li ella devarim sheyyesh bahen hatava veharaa, devarim sheen bahen haraa vahatava minnayin? amar lo: meribbuy hakkatuv. amar lo: im ribba hakkatuv lechach, ribba hakkatuv lechach!
Shappir ka amar leh rabbi akiva lerabbi yishmael!

Amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yishmael – sheshshimmesh et rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana, shehaya doresh et kol hattora kullah bichlal uferat – ihu name doresh bichlal uferat. rabbi akiva – sheshshimmesh et nachum ish gam zo, shehaya doresh et kol hattora kullah beribba umiet – ihu name doresh ribba umiet.
May rabbi akiva dedaresh ribbuye umiute? detanya: "o nefesh ki tishshava" – ribba, "lehara o lehetiv" – miet, "lechol asher yevatte haadam" – chazar veribba; ribba umiet veribba – ribba hakkol.
May ribba? ribba kol mille, umay miet? miet devar mitzva.

Verabbi yishmael daresh kelal uferat: "o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim" – kelal, "lehara o lehetiv" – perat, "lechol asher yevatte haadam" – chazar vechalal; kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella cheen happerat; ma happerat meforash – lehabba, af kol lehabba.
Ahani kelala, leetoye afillu devarim sheen bahen haraa vahatava lehabba; ahani perata, lemaote afillu devarim sheyyesh bahen haraa vahatava lesheavar.
Efoch ana!
Amar rabbi yitzchak: dumeya dilhara o lehetiv" – mi sheissuro mishshum "bal yachel devaro"; yatzata zo, sheen issuro mishshum "bal yachel devaro", ella mishshum "bal teshakkeru".

Rav yitzchak bar avin amar, amar kera: "o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim" – mi shehashshevua kodemet labbittuy, velo shehabbittuy kodemet lashshevua; yatza ze "achalti" velo achalti", shehammaase kodem lashshevua.
Tanu rabbanan: "haadam bishvua" – perat leanus. "venelam" – perat lemezid.
"Mimmennu" – shennitallema mimmennu shevua. yachol shennitallema mimmennu chefetz? talmud lomar: "bishvua venelam" – al helem shevua hu chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al helem chefetz.
Amar mar: "haadam bishvua" – perat leanus. hechi dame?

Kidrav kahana verav assi, ki havo kayymi mikkamme derav, mar amar: shevuata dehachi amar rav, umar amar: shevuata dehachi amar rav. ki ato lekammeh derav, amar kechad minnayyhu. amar leh iddach: vaana beshikra ishtevai?!
Amar leh: libbach anasach.
"Venelam mimmennu" – shennitallem mimmennu shevua. yachol shennitallem mimmennu chefetz? talmud lomar: "bishvua venelam mimmennu" – al helem shevua hu chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al helem chefetz.

Machachu aleh bemareva: bishlama shevua – mashkachat la bela chefetz, kegon deamar: "shevua shello ochal pat chittin", uchesavur "sheochal" kaamar – dishvuateh inneshi, cheftza dechir; ella chefetz belo shevua, hechi dame?
Kegon deamar: "shevua shello ochal pat chittin", uchesavur "shel seorim" kaamar – dishvuateh dechir leh, cheftza inneshi. kevan decheftza inneshi lehu, hayeynu helem shevua!
Ella amar rabbi elazar: da veda achat hi.

Matkef la rav yosef: alma chefetz belo shevua la mashkachat la? veha mashkachat la – kegon deamar "shevua shello ochal pat chittin", vehoshit yado lassal littol pat seorin; vealta beyado shel chittin, uchesavur seorim hi vaachalah; dishvuateh dechir leh, cheftza hu dela yada leh!
Amar leh abbaye: kelum mechayyeyvat leh korban – ella ammay ditfis bideh; helem shevua hu!
Lishshana acharina – amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: sof sof, korban deka mayyte ala dehay pat mihat, helem shevua hu!
Verav yosef amar lach: kevan dechi yada leh dechittin hu – paresh minneh, helem chefetz hu.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: helem ze veze beyado, mahu? amar leh: hare helem shevua beyado, vechayyayv. adderabba, hare helem chefetz beyado, ufatur!
Amar rav ashe: chazenan; i mechamat shevua ka faresh – hare helem shevua beyado, vechayyayv; i mechamat chefetz ka faresh – hare helem chefetz beyado, ufatur.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: kelum paresh mishshevua – ella mishshum chefetz! kelum paresh mechefetz – ella mishshum shevua! ella la shena.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman:
b: Ezo hi shiggat shevuat bittuy lesheavar? i deyada – mezid hu! i dela yada – anus hu!
Amar leh, beomer: "yodea ani sheshshevua zo asura, aval eni yodea im chayyayvin aleha korban o lav".
Keman – kemonbaz, deamar: shiggat korban shemah shegaga?
Afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh demonbaz – ella bechol hattora kullah, delav chiddush hu; aval hacha, dechiddush hu – divchol hattora kullah la ashkechan lav demayyte korban,
Deyalfinan meavoda zara; vehacha mayyte – afillu rabbanan modu.
Bea minneh ravina merava: nishba al kikkar umistakken aleha, mahu?
Mistakken – lishre leh mar! ella mitztaer, vaachalah beshiggat shevua – may?
Amar leh, tenena: shav midiato – mevi korban al shiggato; lo shav midiato – en mevi korban al shiggato.
Amar shemuel: gamar belibbo – tzarich sheyyotzi bisfatav; shenneemar: "levatte bisfatayim".
Metivi: "bisfatayim" – velo ballev; gamar belibbo minnayin? talmud lomar: "lechol asher yevatte haadam bishvua".
Ha gufa kashya – amrat "bisfatayim" velo ballev, vahadar amrat "gamar belibbo minnayin"?!
Amar rav sheshet: ha la kashya; hachi kaamar: "bisfatayim" – velo sheggamar belibbo lehotzi bisfatav velo hotzi; gamar belibbo setam minnayin? talmud lomar: "lechol asher yevatte".
Ella lishmuel kashya!

Amar rav sheshet, taretz veema hachi: "bisfatayim" – velo sheggamar belibbo lehotzi "pat chittin" vehotzi "pat seorin"; gamar belibbo lehotzi "pat chittin" vehotzi "pat" setam, minnayin? talmud lomar: "lechol asher yevatte haadam".
Metivi: "motza sefatecha tishmor veasita" – en li ella shehotzi bisfatav; gamar belibbo minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol nediv lev"!
Shane hatam, dichtiv "kol nediv lev".
Venigmar minna!
Mishshum dehavu teruma vekadashim shene ketuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin – may ikka lememar?
Havu chullin vekadashim, vechullin mikkodashim la gamrinan.

a: Mishna nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bittel – patur. lekayyem velo kiyyem – patur; shehaya baddin sheyyehe chayyayv, kedivre rabbi yehuda ben betera.
Amar rabbi yehuda ben betera: ma im harshut, sheeno musheba alav mehar sinay – hare hu chayyayv alav; mitzva, shehu musheba aleha mehar sinay – eno din sheyyehe chayyayv aleha?!
Amru lo: lo im amarta bishvuat harshut – shekken asa bah lav kehen, tomar bishvuat mitzva – shello asa bah lav kehen; sheim nishba levattel velo bittel – patur.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: yachol nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bittel, yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "lehara o lehetiv" – ma hatava reshut, af haraa reshut; otzi nishba levattel et hammitzva velo bittel, shehu patur.
Yachol nishba lekayyem et hammitzva velo kiyyem, sheyyehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "lehara o lehetiv" – ma haraa reshut, af hatava reshut; otzi nishba lekayyem et hammitzva velo kiyyem, shehu patur.
Yachol nishba lehara leatzmo velo hara – yachol yehe patur? talmud lomar: "lehara o lehetiv" – ma hatava reshut, af haraa reshut; avi nishba lehara leatzmo velo hera, sheharshut beyado.

Yachol nishba lehara laacherim velo hera, sheyyehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "lehara o lehetiv" – ma hatava reshut, af haraa reshut; otzi nishba lehara laacherim velo hera, sheen harshut beyado. minnayin lerabbot hatavat acherim? talmud lomar: "o lehetiv". veezo hi haraat acherim? "akke et peloni vaafatztzea et mocho".
Umimmay dikrae bidvar harshut ketivi? dilma bidvar mitzva ketivi!
La salka datach; devaenan hatava dumeya daharaa, vaharaa dumeya dahatava; deakkesh haraa lahatava – ma hatava enah bevittul mitzva, af haraa enah bevittul mitzva. haraa gufah – hatava hi.
Veakkesh hatava laharaa – ma haraa enah bekiyyum mitzva, af hatava enah bekiyyum mitzva. hatava gufa – haraa hi.
I hachi, bidvar harshut name la mashkachat la!
Ella middeitzterich "o" lerabbot hatavat acherim – shema minna bidvar harshut ketivi. dei salka datach bidvar mitzva ketivi; hasheta haraat acherim itrabbay, hatavat acherim mibbaya?!
Vehay "o" – mibbee leh lechallek! lechallek la tzerich kera.
Hanicha lerabbi yonatan, ella lerabbi yoshiyya may ikka lememar?

Detanya: "ish asher yekallel et aviv veet immo" – en li ella aviv veimmo; aviv velo immo, immo velo aviv – minnayin? talmud lomar: "aviv veimmo killel" – aviv killel, immo killel. divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Rabbi yonatan omer: mashma shenehem keechad umashma echad bifne atzmo,
b: Ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv "yachdav".
Afillu tema rabbi yoshiyya; vesavar la kerabbi akiva dedaresh ribbuye umiute, veiyyaytar leh "o" lechallek.
I amrat bishlama bidvar harshut ketiv, memaet devar mitzva; ella i amrat bidvar mitzva ketiv, mimmay ka memaet?
Amar rabbi yehuda ben betera: ma im harshut kulei. verabbanan – shappir kaamri leh lerabbi yehuda ben betera!

Verabbi yehuda ben betera amar lach: attu hatavat acherim – lav af al gav deleta bichlal haraat acherim, verabbi rachamana? hacha name bekiyyum mitzva – af al gav deleteh bevittul mitzva, rabbeyeh rachamana.
Verabbanan – hatam, iteh belo etiv"; hacha mi iteh belo akayyem"?!
Mishna "shevua shello ochal kikkar zo"; "shevua shello ochlenna"; "shevua shello ochlenna"; vaachalah – eno chayyayv ella achat.
Zo hi shevuat bittuy – shechayyayvin al zedonah makkot, veal shiggatah korban ole veyored.
Shevuat shav – chayyayvin al zedonah makkot, veal shiggatah patur.
Gemara lema li lemitne "shevua shello ochal", "shevua shello ochlenna"?
Ha ka mashma lan: tama deamar "shello ochal" vahadar amar "shello ochlenna" – dela michayyayv ella chada; aval amar "shello ochlenna" vahadar amar "shello ochal" – michayyayv tarte.
Kidrava – deamar rava: "shevua shello ochal kikkar zo", kevan sheachal mimmenna kezayit – chayyayv. "shello ochlenna" – eno chayyayv ad sheyyochal et kullah.
"Shevua shello ochlenna", vaachalah – eno chayyayv ella achat kulei. ha tu lema li?
Ha ka mashma lan: chiyyuva hu delekka – ha shevua ikka; dei mashkachat ravvcha – chayyla.
Lemay hilcheta? lechidrava – deamar rava: sheim nishal al harishona – alta lo sheniyya tachteha.
Lema mesayyeya leh: mi shennadar shete nezirot, umana rishona vehifrish aleha korban, veachar kach nishal al harishona – alta lo sheniyya barishona.
Hachi hasheta?! hatam nezirut miha ita, dechi mane lerishona, bae mihdar mimna lishniyya bela sheela. hacha, shevua sheniyya mi ita kelal?!
Amar rava: nishba al kikkar vaachalah – im shiyyer mimmenna kezayit, nishal aleha; achalah kullah, en nishal aleha.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: hechi dame? i deamar "shello ochal" – mikkezayit kamma avdeh leissureh! i deamar "shello ochlenna" – may irya kezayit?

a: Afillu kol shehu name!
I baet ema "shello ochal", i baet ema "shello ochlenna". ibbaet ema "shello ochal" – miggo demahneya leh sheela akkezayit batra, mahneya leh sheela name akkezayit kamma.
Veibbaet ema "shello ochlenna" – i shayyayr kezayit, chashiv leitteshole aleh; vei la, la chashiv leitteshole aleh.
Metivi: mi shennadar shete nezirot, umana rishona vehifrish aleha korban, veachar kach nishal al harishona – alta lo sheniyya barishona!
Hacha bemay askinan – beshello kipper.
Vehatanya: kipper! beshello gillach – verabbi eliezer hi, deamar tiglachat meakkeva.
Vehatanya: gillach! amar rav ashe: nezirot ka ramet? mi garam lashsheniyya shello tachul – rishona; veenah.

Ammemar amar: afillu achalah kullah, nishal aleha; i beshogeg – mechussar korban, i bemezid – mechussar malkot. aval kefatuhu al haammud – la; kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: kefatuhu al haammud veratz mibbet din – patur.
Vela hi; hatam ratz, hacha la ratz.
Amar rava: "shevua shello ochal kikkar zo im ochal zo", veachal et harishona beshogeg vehashsheniyya bemezid – patur. rishona bemezid usheniyya beshogeg – chayyayv. shetehen beshogeg – patur.
b: Shetehen bemezid – achleh litnaeh vahadar achleh leissureh, michayyayv; achleh leissureh vahadar achleh litnaeh, pelugeta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish – leman deamar hateraat safek shemah hateraa, chayyayv; leman deamar lav shemah hateraa, patur.
Telaan zo bazo – "lo ochal zo im ochal zo", "lo ochal zo im ochal zo"; veachal zo bizdon atzmah uveshiggat chavertah, vezo bizdon atzmah uveshiggat chavertah – patur.
Zo beshiggat atzmah uvezadon chavertah, vezo beshiggat atzmah uvizdon chavertah – chayyayv.
Shetehen beshogeg – patur.
Shetehen bemezid – ashsheniyya michayyayv, arishona pelugeta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish.
Amar rav mari, af anan name tenena: arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim – nidre zeruzin, nidre havay, nidre shegagot, nidre ovnasin.

Nidre shegagot ketzad? "kunnam im achalti veim shatiti", venizkar sheachal veshata; "sheeni ochel sheeni shote", shachach veachal veshata – muttar. vetane ala: keshem shennidre shegagot muttarin, kach shevuot shegagot muttarot.
Shevuot shegagot hechi dame – lav ki hay gavvna? shema minna.

Efa tane shevuot be rabba. pega beh avimi achu, amar leh: "shevua shello achalti" "shevua shello achalti", mahu? amar leh: eno chayyayv ella achat. amar leh: ishtabbasht, hare yatza shevua lashsheker!
"Shevua shello ochal tesha veeser", mahu? chayyayv al kol achat veachat. amar leh: ishtabbasht, i tesha la achel, eser la achel!
"Shevua shello ochal eser vatesha", mahu? eno chayyayv ella achat. amar leh: ishtabbasht, eser hu dela achel, ha tesha miha achel!
Amar abbaye: zimnin demashkachat la leha deefa, kidmar. deamar rabba: "shevua shello ochal teenim vaanavim", vechazar veamar: "shevua shello ochal teenim";

a: Veachal teenim vehifrish korban, veachar kach achal anavim lechodayyhu – havya lehu anavim chatzi shiur, veachatzi shiur la michayyayv korban. hacha name, kegon deamar: "shevua shello ochal eser", vechazar veamar: "shevua shello ochal tesha", veachal tesha vehifrish korban, veachar kach achal asirit; havya la asirit chatzi shiur, veachatzi shiur la michayyayv.
Mishna ezo hi shevuat shav? nishba leshannot et hayyadua laadam – amar al haammud shel even shehu shel zahav, veal haish shehu ishsha, veal haishsha shehi ish;
Nishba al davar shei efshar lo – "im lo raiti gamal shepporeach baavir" veim lo raiti nachash kekorat bet habbad";

Amar leedim: "bou vehaiduni", "shevua shello neidecha"; nishba levattel et hammitzva – shello laasot sukka veshello littol lulav veshello lehanniach tefillin; zo hi shevuat shav, shechayyayvin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah patur.
"Shevua sheochal kikkar zo", "shevua shello ochlenna" – harishona shevuat bittuy, vehashsheniyya shevuat shav.
Achalah – avar al shevuat shav. lo achalah – avar al shevuat bittuy.
Gemara amar ulla: vehu shennikkar lishlosha bene adam.

Nishba al davar shei efshar lo – "im lo raiti gamal poreach baavir". "shevua sheraiti" la kaamar, may "im lo raiti"? abbaye amar: tane "shevua sheraiti". rava amar: beomer "yeasru kol perot shebbeolam alay, im lo raiti gamal poreach baavir".
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vedilma hay gavra tzippora rabba chazi, veassek leh shema "gamla", vechi ka mishteva – addateh dideh ishteva?

Vechi tema: batar pummeh azlinan, vela azlinan batar dateh – veha tanya: keshemmashbiin oto omrim lo: "heve yodea, shello al datecha anu mashbiin otcha, ella al datenu veal daat bet din". may tama? lav mishshum deamrinan: dilma iskunedre yehayv leh veassek lehu "zuze", dechi ka mishteva – addateh dideh ka mishteva?
La, hatam mishshum kanya derava.

Ta shema: vechen matzinu keshehishbia moshe et yisrael, amar lahen: "deu shello al datechem ani mashbia etchem, ella al daat hammakom veal dati". veammay? lema lehu: "kayyimu may daamar eloah"! lav mishshum demasseki addatayyhu avoda zara?
La; mishshum daavoda zara name ikkeri "eloah", dichtiv: "elohe chesef velohe zahav".

Velema lehu: "kayyimu tora"! chada tora. velema: "kayyimu shete torot"! "torat chattat" "torat asham". "kayyimu kol hattora kullah"! avoda zara, deamar mar: chamura avoda zara, shekkol hakkofer bah kemode bechol hattora kullah.
Velema lehu: "kayyimu mitzva"! chada mitzva. "kayyimu mitzvot!" tarte. "kol hammitzvot kullan"! mitzvat tzitzit, deamar mar: shekula mitzvat tzitzit keneged kol hammitzvot kullan.
Velema lehu: "kayyimu shesh meot ushelosh esre mitzvot"! uletaamech, lema lehu: "al dati"; "al daat hammakom" lema li?
b: Ella ki hechi dela tihve hafara lishvuatayyhu.
Veim lo raiti nachash kekorat bet habbad". vela?! veha hahu dahava bishne shabbur malka, hava chad deachzek telesar uravavta tivna!
Amar shemuel: betaruf. kullehu name mitraf terifin! besheggabbo taruf.
"Shevua sheochal kikkar zo", "shevua shello ochlenna" kulei. hasheta mishshum shevuat bittuy michayyayv, mishshum shevuat shav la michayyayv?! hare yatzta shevua lashshav!
Amar rabbi yirmeya, tane: af al shevuat bittuy.

Mishna shevuat bittuy noheget baanashim uvenashim, bikrovim uvirchokim, bichsherin uvifsulin, bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din – mippi atzmo. vechayyayvin al zedonah makkot, veal shiggatah korban ole veyored.
Shevuat shav noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokim uvikrovim, bichsherin uvifsulin, bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din – umippi atzmo. vechayyayvin al zedonah makkot, veal shiggatah patur.
Achat zo veachat zo, hammusheba mippi acherim chayyayv – "im lo achalti hayyom" velo hinnachti tefillin hayyom"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – chayyayv.
Gemara amar shemuel: kol haone "amen" achar shevua – kemotzi shevua befiv dame, dichtiv: "veamra haishsha amen amen".

Amar rav pappa mishshemeh derava: matnitin uvarayyta name dayka, dekatane: shevuat haedut noheget baanashim velo benashim, birchokim velo bikrovim, bichsherin velo bifsulin; veenah noheget ella biruyin lehaid, uvifne bet din veshello bifne bet din – mippi atzmo; umippi acherim enan chayyayvin, ad sheyyichperu bahen bevet din. divre rabbi meir.

Vetanya bevarayyta: shevuat haedut ketzad? amar leedim: "bou vehaiduni"; "shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut", o sheamru: "en anu yodin lach edut"; "mashbia ani alechem", veamru (lo) "amen" – ben bifne bet din ben shello bifne bet din, ben mippi atzmo ben mippi acherim, kevan shekkafru bahem – chayyayvin. divre rabbi meir.
Kashyayn ahadade! ella lav shema minna: ha deana "amen", ha dela ana "amen"? shema minna.

Amar ravina mishshemeh derava: matnitin dehacha name dayka – deka tane: "shevuat bittuy noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokim uvikrovim, bichsherin uvifsulin, bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din – mippi atzmo in, mippi acherim la; vekatane sefa: "ze vaze musheba mippi acherim – chayyayv".
Kashyayn ahadade! ella lav shema minna: ha deana "amen", ha dela ana "amen"?
Veella shemuel – may ka mashma lan? dukeya dematnitin ka mashma lan.
Hadaran alach shevuot shetayim

a: Mishna shevuat haedut noheget baanashim velo benashim, birchokin velo bikrovin, bichsherin velo bifsulin; veenah noheget ella biruyin lehaid.

Bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din – mippi atzmo, umippi acherim en chayyayvin ad sheyyichperu bahen bevet din. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ben mippi atzmo uven mippi acherim – enan chayyayvin ad sheyyichperu bahen bevet din.
Vechayyayvin al zedon hashshevua, veal shiggatah im zedon haedut, veenan chayyayvin al shiggatah. uma hen chayyayvin al zedon hashshevua? korban ole veyored.
Gemara menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "veamdu shene haanashim" – beedim hakkatuv medabber.

Atta omer beedim, o eno ella bevaale dinin? keshehu omer "asher lahem hariv" – hare baale dinin amur; ha ma ani mekayyem "veamdu shene haanashim"? beedim hakkatuv medabber. veim nafshecha lomar: neemar kan "shene" veneemar lehallan "shene"; ma lehallan beedim, af kan beedim.
May "im nafshecha lomar"? vechi tema: middela ketiv "vaasher lahem hariv"– kulleh kera bevaale dinin mishtae; neemar kan "shene" veneemar lehallan "shene", ma lehallan beedim af kan beedim.

Tanya iddach: "veamdu shene haanashim" – beedim hakkatuv medabber. atta omer beedim, o eno ella bevaale dinin? amrat: vechi shenayim baim ledin, shelosha en bain ladin?! veim nafshecha lomar: neemar kan "shene" veneemar lehallan "shene", ma lehallan beedim, af kan beedim.
May "im nafshecha lomar"? vechi tema: betovea venitba ka mishtae kera; neemar kan "shene" veneemar lehallan "shene", ma lehallan beedim af kan beedim.

Tanya iddach: "veamdu shene haanashim" – beedim hakkatuv medabber. atta omer beedim, o eno ella bevaale dinin? amrat: vechi anashim bain laddin, nashim en baot laddin?! veim nafshecha lomar: neemar kan "shene" veneemar lehallan "shene", ma lehallan beedim af kan beedim.
May "im nafshecha lomar"? vechi tema: ishsha lav orcha, mishshum "kol kevudda vat melech penima"; neemar kan "shene" veneemar lehallan "shene", ma lehallan beedim af kan beedim.

Tanu rabbanan: "veamdu shene haanashim" – mitzva levaale dinin sheyyaamdu. amar rabbi yehuda: shamati sheim ratzu lehoshiv et shenehem – moshivin; ezehu asur? shello yehe echad omed veechad yoshev, echad medabber kol tzarko veechad omer lo "katztzer devarecha".

Tanu rabbanan: "betzedek tishpot amitecha" – shello yehe echad yoshev veechad omed, echad medabber kol tzarko veechad omer lo: "katztzer devarecha". davar acher: "betzedek tishpot amitecha" – heve dan et chavercha lechaf zechut.
Tane rav yosef: "betzedek tishpot amitecha" – im sheittecha betora uvemitzvot, hishtaddel leduno yafe.
Rav ulla bereh derav illay hava leh dina kammeh derav nachman. shelach leh rav yosef: ulla chaverenu amit betora uvemitzvot. amar: lemay shelach li? lechannofe leh?! hadar amar: lemishre betigreh,
b: I name leshuda dedayyayne.

Amar ulla: machloket bevaale dinin; aval beedim – divre hakkol baamida, dichtiv: "veamdu shene haanashim". amar rav huna: machloket bishat massa umattan; aval bishat gemar din – divre hakkol dayyaynin bishiva uvaale dinin baamida, dichtiv: "vayyashev moshe lishpot et haam vayyaamod haam".
Lishshana acharina: machloket bishat massa umattan, aval bishat gemar din – divre hakkol dayyaynin bishiva uvaale dinin baamida; deha edim kigmar din damu, uchetiv behu: "veamdu shene haanashim".

Devethu derav huna hava la dina kammeh derav nachman, amar: hechi naaved? i ekum mikkamma – mistatteman taanateh devaal dina. la ekum mikkamma – eshet chaver hare hi kechaver. amar leh leshammaeh: tze veafrach alay bar avavza ushedi illavavy, veekum.

Vehaamar mar: machloket bishat massa umattan, aval bishat gemar din – divre hakkol dayyaynim bishiva uvaale dinin baamida! deyatev keman deshare mesaneh, veamar: "ish peloni atta zakkay", "ish peloni atta chayyayv".
Amar rabba bar rav huna: hay tzureba merabbanan veam haaretz deit lehu dina bahade hadade – motvinan leh letzureba merabbanan, uleam haaretz name amrinan leh "tiv"; vei kae – let lan ba.

Rav bar sherevya hava leh dina kammeh derav pappa, otveh veotev name levaal dineh. ata shelicha deve dina, betash beh veokmeh leam haaretz, vela amar leh rav pappa "tiv". hechi aved hachi? veha mistatteman taanateh! amar rav pappa: memar amar, ihu ha otvan, shelicha hu dela mippayyays minnay.

Veamar rabba bar rav huna: hay tzureba merabbanan veam haaretz deit lehu dina bahade hadade, la likdom tzureba merabbanan velittev, mishshum demichaze keman desadar leh ledineh. vela amaran ella dela kevia leh iddaneh, aval kevia leh iddaneh – let lan ba; memar amar: beiddaneh terid.

Veamar rabba bar rav huna: hay tzureba merabbanan deyada besahaduta, vezila beh milleta lemezal leve dayyayna dezutar minneh leashode kammeh – la lezil. amar rav shisha bereh derav idi, af anan name tenena: matza sak o kuppa veen darko littol – hare ze lo yittol.
Hane mille bemamona, aval beissura – "en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai"; kol makom sheyyesh bo chillul Adonai – en cholkin kavod lerav.

Rav yemar hava yada leh sahaduta lemar zutera. ata lekammeh deammemar, otvinhu lechullehu. amar leh rav ashe leammemar, vehaamar ulla: machloket bevaale dinin, aval beedim – divre hakkol baamida! amar leh: hay ase vehay ase, vaase dichvod tora adif.
(Siman: sanegaron, bur, gezelat, mirma)

Tanu rabbanan: minnayin laddayyayn shello yaase sanigaron lidvarav? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak". uminnayin laddayyayn shello yeshev talmid bur lefanav? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak".
Minnayin laddayyayn sheyyodea lachavero shehu gazlan, vechen ed sheyyodea bachavero shehu gazlan – minnayin shello yitztaref immo? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak".
Minnayin laddayyayn sheyyodea baddin shehu merumme, shello yomar: hoil vehaedim meidin – echtechennu, vihe

a: Kolar taluy betzavvar edim? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak".
(Siman: telata talmid, utelat baale chov, semartut shomea umatim)
Minnayin letalmid sheyyoshev lifne rabbo veroe zechut leani vechov leashir – minnayin shello yishtok? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak".

Minnayin letalmid sheroe et rabbo shettoe baddin, shello yomar: amtin lo ad sheyyigmerennu; veesterennu veevnennu mishshelli, kede sheyyikkare haddin al shemi? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak".

Minnayin letalmid sheamar lo rabbo: yodea atta bi sheim notnin li mea mane eni mevadde; mane yesh li etzel peloni, veen li alav ella ed echad – minnayin shello yitztaref immo? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak".

Hay middevar sheker tirchak" nafka?! ha vadday shakkore ka meshakker, verachamana amar: "lo taane vereacha ed shaker"! ella kegon daamar leh: vadday chad sahada it li, veta atta kum hatam vela tema vela midde, deha la mappekat mippummach shikra – afillu hachi asur, mishshum shenneemar: "middevar sheker tirchak".
Minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane, shello yomar: etanennu bematayim – kede sheyyode li bemane, veyitchayyev li shevua, vaagalgel alav shevua mimmakom acher? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak".

Minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane uteano matayim, shello yomar: echperennu bevet din veode lo chutz levet din, kede shello etchayyev lo shevua velo yegalgel alay shevua mimmakom acher? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak".
Minnayin lishlosha shennoshin mane beechad, shello yehe echad baal din ushenayim edim, kede sheyyotziu mane veyachloku? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak".

Minnayin lishnayim shebbau laddin, echad lavush semartutin veechad lavush itztelit bat mea mane, sheomrin lo: levosh kemoto o halebishehu kemotcha? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak". ki havo atu lekammeh derava bar rav huna, amar lehu: shelufu puzemukayychu vechutu ledina.
Minnayin ledayyayn shello yishma divre baal din (chavero) kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak".
Minnayin levaal din shello yatim devarav laddayyayn kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero? talmud lomar: "middevar sheker tirchak". rav kahana matne millo tissa" – "lo tassi".
"Vaasher lo tov asa betoch ammav" – rav amar: ze habba behareshaa, ushemuel amar: ze hallokeach sade sheyyesh aleha asikin.
Enah noheget ella biruyin lehaid kulei. leappoke may? amar rav pappa: leappoke melech. verav acha bar yaakov amar: leappoke mesachek bekuveya.
Man deamar mesachek bekuveya – kol shekken melech; uman deamar melech – aval mesachek bekuveya, middeorayyta michza chaze, verabbanan hu defasluhu.
Bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din kulei. bemay kamippalgi?
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa: bedun minna uminna – bedun minna veoke veatra ka mippalgi.

Rabbi meir savar: dun minna uminna mippikkadon; ma pikkadon – musheba mippi atzmo chayyayv, af edut – musheba mippi atzmo chayyayv, uminna, ma pikkadon – ben bevet din uven shello bevet din, af edut – ben bevet din uven shello bevet din.

Verabbanan savri: dun minna veoke beatra; ma pikkadon – musheba mippi atzmo chayyayv, af edut – musheba mippi atzmo chayyayv. veoke beatra: ma musheba mippi acherim – bevet din in, shello bevet din la; af musheba mippi atzmo – bevet din in, shello bevet din la.
b: Amar lehu rav pappa: i mippikkadon gamri la rabbanan, dechulle alma la peligi dedun minna uminna.
Ella hayeynu tama derabbanan – demayytu la bekal vachomer: uma mippi acherim chayyayv, mippi atzmo lo kol shekken?!

Umiddemayytu la mikkal vachomer – dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon: ma musheba mippi acherim – bevet din in, shello bevet din la; af musheba mippi atzmo – bifne bet din in, shello bifne bet din la.

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav pappa: mi matzet amrat delav bedun minna uminna peligi?! vehatnan gabbe pikkadon: shevuat happikkadon noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokin uvikrovin, bichsherin uvifsulin, bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din – mippi atzmo; umippi acherim eno chayyayv ad sheyyichpor bo bevet din. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ben mippi atzmo uven mippi acherim – kevan shekkafar bo chayyayv.
Musheba mippi acherim befikkadon mena lehu lerabbanan dechayyayv? lav degamri la meedut – ushema minna bedun minna uminna peligi?
Mehahi – in; meha – lekka lemishma minna.
Vechayyayvin al zedon hashshevua. menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: bechullan neemar bahen "venelam", vechan lo neemar bah "venelam"; lechayyev al hammezid kashshogeg.
Veal shiggatah im zedon haedut. hechi dame shiggatah im zedon haedut? amar rav yehuda amar rav: beomer "yodea ani sheshshevua zo asura, aval eni yodea im chayyayvin aleha korban im lo".
Veen chayyayvin al shiggatah geredta. lema tenena lidrav kahana uderav assi?
La; af al gav ditnan, itzterich; salka datach amena: hacha hu dela ketiv "venelam" devaenan shogeg dumeya demezid; aval hatam dichtiv "venelam", afillu shiggatah kol dehu; ka mashma lan.

Mishna shevuat haedut ketzad? amar lishnayim: "bou vehaiduni"; "shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut", o sheamru lo "en anu yodin lecha edut"; "mashbia ani alechem", veamru: "amen" – hare ellu chayyayvin.

Hishbia alehem chamesh peamim chutz levet din, uvau levet din vehodu – peturin. kafru – chayyayvin al kol achat veachat. hishbia alehen chamesh peamim bifne bet din vechafru – enan chayyayvin ella achat. amar rabbi shimon: ma taam? hoil veenam yecholin lachzor ulehodot.
Kafru shenehen keechad – shenehen chayyayvin. beze achar ze – harishon chayyayv vehashsheni patur. kafar echad vehoda echad – hakkofer chayyayv.
Hayu shete kitte edim, kafra harishona veachar kach kafra hashsheniyya – shetehen chayyayvot, mippene shehaedut yechola lehitkayyem bishtehen.

Gemara amar shemuel: rauhu sheratz acharehen, amru lo: "ma atta ratz acharenu? shevua sheen anu yodin lach edut" – peturin, ad sheyyishmeu mippiv. may ka mashma lan? tenena: shillach beyad avdo, o sheamar lahen hannitba: "mashbia ani alechem, sheim attem yodin lo edut – shettavou uteiduhu" – hare ellu peturim,

a: Ad sheyyishmeu mippi hattovea!
Ratz acharehen itztericha leh; salka datach amena: kevan deratz acharehen – keman deamar lehu dame; ka mashma lan.
Veha name tenena: shevuat haedut ketzad? amar leedim "bou vehaiduni", "shevua" kulei – amar in, la amar la!
"Amar" lav davka.
Dei la tema hachi, gabbe pikkadon dekatane: shevuat happikkadon ketzad? amar lo: "ten li pikkadon sheyyesh li beyadcha" ; hacha name – amar in, la amar la?! ha "vechichesh baamito" kol dehu!
Ella "amar" lav davka; hacha name lav davka.
Hay may? i amrat bishlama "amar" dehacha davka – tena hatam attu hacha. ella i amrat la "amar" dehatam davka vela "amar" dehacha davka – "amar" "amar" lema li lemitneyay?
Dilma orcha demilleta ka mashma lan.
Tanya kevavteh dishmuel: rauhu shebba acharehen, amru lo: "ma atta ba acharenu? shevua sheen anu yodin lach edut" – peturin. veim befikkadon – chayyayvim.
Hishbia alehen chamishsha peamim kulei.
Menalan deakkefira bevet din hu dimchayyeyvi, achutz levet din la michayyeyvi?
Amar abbaye, amar kera: "im lo yaggid venasa avono" – lo amarti lecha ella bimkom sheillu maggid ze, mitchayyev ze mamon.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: i hachi, ema shevua gufa – bevet din en, veshello bevet din la!

La salka datach, detanya: "leachat" – lechayyev al kol achat veachat. vei salka datach bevet din, mi mechayyev al kol achat veachat?! vehatnan: hishbia alehen chamishsha peamim bifne bet din vechafru – en chayyayvin ella achat. amar rabbi shimon: ma taam? hoil veenam yecholin lachzor ulehodot. ella lav shema minna: shevua – chutz levet din, kefira – bevet din?
Kafru shenehen keachat – chayyayvin. ha i efshar letzamtzem?
Amar rav chisda: ha manni – rabbi yose haggelili hi, deamar efshar letzamtzem.
Rabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbanan, kegon shekkafru shenehen betoch kede dibbur – vetoch kede dibbur kedibbur dame.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: mikkedi toch kede dibbur kamma have – kede sheelat talmid larav, ikka deamri: kede sheelat harav lattalmid; ad deamri "shevua sheen anu yodin lach edut", tuva have! amar leh: kol echad veechad toch dibburo shel chavero.
Beze achar ze – harishon chayyayv vehashsheni patur. matnitin dela ki hay tanna – detanya: mashbia ed echad – patur, verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mechayyev.
Lema beha kamippalgi – demar savar: ed echad ki ate – lishvua hu deka ate; umar savar: ed echad ki ata – lemamona ka ate?
Vetisbera?! haamar abbaye: hakkol modim beed sota, vehakkol modim beede sota, umachloket beede sota; hakkol modim beed echad, vehakkol modim beed shekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua.
Ella dechulle alma ed echad ki ate – lishvua ka ate; vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar davar haggorem lemamon – kemamon dame, umar savar lav kemamon dame.
Gufa – amar abbaye: hakkol modim beed sota, vehakkol modim beede sota, umachloket beede sota; hakkol modim beed echad, vehakkol modim beed shekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua.
Hakkol modim beed sota – shechayyayv, beed tumea; derachamana hemneh, dichtiv "veed en bah" – kol sheyyesh bah.
Vehakkol modim beede sota – sheppatur, beede kinnuy; dehave gorem degorem.
b: Umachloket beede sota – beede setira; mar savar: davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame – vechayyayv, umar savar: lav kemamon dame – ufatur.
Hakkol modim beshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua, hakkol modim beed echad derabbi abba.
Hakkol modim beshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua – dachashid man? ilema dachashid love, deamar leh malve: i atet ashedt li, hava mishtevana veshakelna; velema leh: mi yemar demishtevat?
Ella kegon sheshshenehen chashuden, deamar mar: chazra shevua lamchuyyav lah, umittoch sheeno yachol lishshava – meshallem.

Hakkol modim beed echad derabbi abba – dehahu gavra dachataf nesacha mechavreh. ata lekammeh derabbi amme, hava yatev rabbi abba kammeh; azal ayyti chad sahada demichtaf chatfa minneh. amar leh: "in, chatafi – vedidi chatafi".

Amar rabbi amme: hechi (lidayyeyne) [lidayyeynu] dayyayne lehay dina? lishallem – lekka tere sahadi! liftereh – ha ikka chad sahada demichtaf chataf! lishteva – kevan deamar "en, chatafi – vedidi chatafi", have leh kegazlan! amar leh rabbi abba: have leh mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava, vechol hamechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava – meshallem.
Amar rav pappa: hakkol modim beed mita shehu chayyayv, vehakkol modim beed mita shehu patur.
Hakkol modim beed mita shehu patur – daamar la ledida vela amar lehu levet din, ditnan: haishsha sheamra "met bali" – tinnase, "met bali" – tityabbem.
Hakkol modim beed mita shehu chayyayv – dela amar ledida vela amar lehu levet din.
Shema minna: mashbia ede karka chayyayv? dilma ditfisa mittaltele.
Kafar echad vehoda echad kulei. hasheta beze achar ze, detarvayyhu ka chafri – amrat harishon chayyayv vehashsheni patur; kafar echad vehoda echad mibbaya?!
La tzericha, kegon shekkafru shenehen, vechazar echad mehen vehoda betoch kede dibbur; veha ka mashma lan – detoch kede dibbur kedibbur dame.

Bishlama lerav chisda, demoke la lehahu kerabbi yose haggelili – resha efshar letzamtzem, vesefa itzterich leashmoinan detoch kede dibbur kedibbur dame. ella lerabbi yochanan – resha toch kede dibbur, sefa toch kede dibbur! tarte lema li?
Mahu detema: hane mille kefira uchefira, aval kefira vehodaa – ema la; ka mashma lan.
Hayu shete kitte edim, kafra harishona veachar kach kafra hashsheniyya. bishlama sheniyya titchayyev – dechafra la rishona; ella rishona ammay?

a: Ha kayyma sheniyya!
Amar ravina: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehayta sheniyya bishat kefirat rishona kerovin binshotehen, uneshotehen gossot; mahu detema: rov gossim lemita, ka mashma lan: hasheta miha la shechev.
Mishna "mashbia ani alechem, im lo tavou uteiduni sheyyesh li beyad peloni pikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda"; "shevua sheen anu yodin lach edut" – en chayyayvin ella achat.
"Shevua sheen anu yodin sheyyesh lecha beyad peloni pikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda" – chayyayvin al kol achat veachat.
"Mashbia ani alechem, im lo tavou vetaidu sheyyesh li beyad peloni pikkadon chittin useorin vechussemin"; "shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut" – en chayyayvin ella achat.
"Shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut sheyyesh lecha beyad peloni chittin useorin vechussemin" – chayyayvin al kol achat veachat.

"Mashbia ani alechem, im lo tavou uteiduni sheyyesh li beyad peloni nezek, vachatzi nezek, tashlume kefel, vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vesheanas ish peloni et bitti, ufitta et bitti, veshehikkani beni, veshechaval bi chaveri, veshehidlik et gedishi beyom hakkippurim" – hare ellu chayyayvin.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: mashbia ede kenas, mahu?
Allibba derabbi elazar berabbi shimon – la tibbee lach, deamar: yavou edim veyaidu.
Ki tibbee lach – allibba derabbanan, deamri: mode biknas veachar kach bau edim – patur.
Verabbanan dehatam, keman sevira lehu? illema kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon dehacha, ha kaamar: davar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame!
Ella kerabbanan dehacha, deamri: davar haggorem lemamon lav kemamon dame. may? kevan deillu mode mippetar – lav mamona ka chafar leh; o dilma, hasheta miha la odi?
Ta shema: "mashbia ani alechem, im lo tavou uteiduni sheyyesh li beyad peloni nezek vachatzi nezek". veha chatzi nezek kenasa hu! keman deamar palga nizka mamona.
Hanicha leman deamar palga nizka mamona; ella leman deamar kenasa, may ikka lememar? bachatzi nezek tzerorot, dehilcheta gemiri la demamona hu.
Ta shema: "tashlume chefel"! mishshum karna.
"Vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha"! mishshum karna.
"Sheanas ish peloni ufitta et bitti"! mishshum boshet ufegam.
May ka mashma lan? kulla mamona hu! resha chada ka mashma lan, sefa chada ka mashma lan; resha chada ka mashma lan – dachatzi nezek tzerorot mamona hu.

Sefa chada ka mashma lan – "veshehidlik et gedishi beyom hakkippurim". leappoke may? leappoke midderabbi nechuneya ben hakkana – detanya: rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana haya ose yom hakkippurim kashshabbat letashlumin, ma shabbat kulei.
Ta shema: "mashbia ani alechem, im lo tavou uteiduni
b: Shehotzi ish peloni shem ra al bitti" – chayyayvin. hoda mippi atzmo – patur.
Ha manni – rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi, deamar: yavou edim veyaidu.
Ema sefa: hoda meatzmo – patur, atan lerabbanan!
Kullah rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi, vehachi kaamar: la mashkachat la hoda mippi atzmo defatur, ella hecha delekka edim kelal vehoda meatzmo.
Mishna "mashbia ani alechem, im lo tavou vetaidu sheani kohen, sheani levi, sheeni ben gerusha, sheeni ben chalutza, sheish peloni kohen, sheish peloni levi, sheeno ben gerusha, sheeno ben chalutza,
Sheanas ish peloni et bitto, ufitta et bitto, veshechaval bi beni, veshechaval bi chaveri, shehidlik gedishi beshabbat" – hare ellu peturin.
Gemara tama deish peloni kohen, deish peloni levi; ha "mane lifloni beyad peloni" – chayyayvin; ha katane sefa: ad sheyyishmeu mippi hattovea!
Amar shemuel: beva behareshaa. vehaamri nehardae: la katvinan orachta ammittalteli! hane mille hecha dechafreh, aval la kafreh – katvinan.

Tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheen hakkatuv medabber ella bitviat mamon? rabbi eliezer omer: neemar kan "oin", veneemar lehallan "oin"; ma lehallan eno medabber ella bitviat mamon, af kan eno medabber ella bitviat mamon.
"Oin" derotzeach yochichu – shehen "oin", umedabberim shello bitviat mamon!
Danin "oin" sheyyesh immahen shevua meoin" sheyyesh immahen shevua, veal yochichu "oin" derotzeach – sheen immahen shevua.
"Oin" desota yochichu – shehen "oin", veyesh immahen shevua, umedabberim shello bitviat mamon!

Danin "oin" sheyyesh immahen shevua veen immahen kohen, meoin" sheyyesh immahen shevua veen immahen kohen; veal yochichu "oin" derotzeach – sheen immahen shevua; veal yochichu "oin" desota – sheaf al pi sheyyesh immahen shevua, yesh immahen kohen.
Rabbi akiva omer: "vehaya ki yesham leachat meelle" – yesh meelle shehu chayyayv, veyesh meelle shehu patur. ha ketzad? tevao mamon – chayyayv, davar acher – patur.
