Rabbi yose haggelili omer: hare hu omer "vehu ed o raa o yada" – beedut hammitkayyemet biriyya belo yedia uvidia belo reaya hakkatuv medabber.
Reiyya belo yedia – ketzad? "mane maniti lecha bifne peloni ufeloni", "yavou peloni ufeloni veyaidu" – zo hi reiyya belo yedia.
Yedia belo reiyya – ketzad? "mane hodeta li bifne peloni ufeloni", "yavou peloni ufeloni veyaidu" – zo hi yedia belo reiyya.
Rabbi shimon omer: chiyyev kan vechiyyev befikkadon; ma lehallan eno medabber ella bitviat mamon, af kan eno medabber ella bitviat mamon.
Veod – kal vachomer: ma pikkadon – sheasa bo nashim kaanashim, kerovim kirchokim, pesulim kichsherim; vechayyayv al

a: Kol achat veachat, bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din – eno medabber ella bitviat mamon; edut shello asa bah nashim kaanashim, kerovim kirchokim, pesulin kichsherim; veeno chayyayv ella achat bifne bet din – eno din shello yehe medabber ella bitviat mamon?!
Ma lefikkadon – shekken lo asa bo musheba kannishba umezid kashshogeg; tomar beedut – shekken asa bah musheba kannishba umezid kashshogeg?!
Talmud lomar: "techeta"–"techeta" ligzera shava – neemar kan "techeta", veneemar lehallan "techeta"; ma lehallan eno medabber ella bitviat mamon, af kan eno medabber ella bitviat mamon.
Matkef la rabba bar ulla: "o" "o" bittuy yochichu – shehen "oin", veyesh immahen shevua, veen immahen kohen – umedabberim shello bitviat mamon!
Mistabbera mippikkadon hava leh lemelaf, shekken "techeta" mittecheta".
Adderabba – mibbittuy hava leh lemelaf, shekken chattat mechattat!
Ella mistabbera mippikkadon hava leh lemelaf – shekken chet; bemezid; taveh vechafreh; veavreh.
Adderabba, mibbittuy hava leh lemelaf, shekken chattat sheyyarda lechomesh! hanach nefishan.
Rabbi akiva omer: "vehaya chi yesham leachat meelle" – yesh meelle shehu chayyayv, veyesh meelle shehu patur. ha ketzad? tevao mamon – chayyayv, tevao davar acher – patur.
Efoch ana!
Rabbi akiva aoin" derabbi eliezer semich.
May benayyhu ben rabbi eliezer uven rabbi akiva?
Ikka benayyhu mashbia ede karka – lerabbi eliezer chayyayvin, lerabbi akiva peturin.
Ulerabbi yochanan, deamar hatam: mashbia ede karka afillu lerabbi eliezer peturin – hacha may ikka ben rabbi eliezer lerabbi akiva?
Ikka benayyhu ede kenas.
Rabbi yose haggelili omer: "vehu ed o raa o yada" – beedut hammitkayyemet biriyya belo yedia uvidia belo reiyya hakkatuv medabber.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: lema rabbi yose haggelili let leh derabbi acha? detanya, rabbi acha omer: gamal haocher ben haggemallim venimtza gamal harug betziddo – beyadua shezze harago. dei it leh derabbi acha, bedine nefashot name mashkachat la – kerabbi shimon ben shatach!

Detanya, amar rabbi shimon ben shatach: ere benechama im lo raiti echad sheratz achar chavero lechureba, veratzti acharav, umatzati sayif beyado vedam metaftef veharug mefarper; amarti lo: rasha! mi harago laze? o ani, o atta!
Aval ma eese, sheen damcha masur beyadi, shehare amra tora: "al pi shenayim edim o shelosha edim yumat hammet". ella hammakom yippara mimmecha. amru: lo zazu mishsham ad shenneshacho nachash vamet.

Afillu tema it leh derabbi acha; bishlama yedia belo reiyya – mashkachat la; ella reiyya belo yedia – hechi mashkachat la? mi la bae midda im goy harag o yisrael harag, im adam terefa harag o shalem harag?

Shema minna, kasavar rabbi yose haggelili: mashbia ede kenas – patur; dei salka datach chayyayv, nehi didia belo reiyya – ashkechan la; reiyya belo yedia – mi la bae midda goya baal bat yisrael baal, betula baal beula baal?
Yatev rav hamenuna kammeh derav yehuda, veyatev rav yehuda veka mibbaya leh: "mane menitich bifne peloni ufeloni",
b: Veedim roin oto mibbachutz, may?
Amar leh rav hamenuna: vehalla ma toen? i amar: "lo hayu devarim meolam" – huchezak kafran! i amar: "in, shekali – vedidi shekali" – ki atu edim may have? amar leh: hamenuna at? ul ta.
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "mane maniti lecha betzad ammud ze", amar leh: "lo avarti betzad ammud ze". ato tere sahadi, ashidu beh dehishtin mayim betzad ammud ze. amar resh lakish: huchezak kafran.
Matkef la rav nachman: hay dina parsaa hu! mi kaamar "meolam"?! beesek ze kaamar leh!

Ikka deamri, hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "mane maniti lecha betzad ammud ze", amar leh: "lo avarti betzad ammud ze meolam". nefaku beh sahadi dehishtin mayim betzad ammud ze. amar rav nachman: huchezak kafran.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: kol milleta dela ramya aleh deinish, aved la velav addateh.
Rabbi shimon omer: chiyyev kan vechiyyev befikkadon kulei.
Machachu ala bemareva. may chucha?
Dekatane: ma lefikkadon, shekken lo asa bo musheba kannishba, mezid kashshogeg.
Mikkede musheba mippi atzmo beedut, lerabbi shimon mena leh – digmar mippikkadon; pikkadon name – musheba mippi acherim, nigmar meedut!
Umay chucha? dilma rabbi shimon bekal vachomer mayyte la: mippi acherim chayyayv – mippi atzmo lo kol shekken?!
Ella chucha ammezid kashshogeg – dekatane: ma lefikkadon – shekken lo asa bo musheba kannishba, mezid kashshogeg.
Mikkede mezid gabbe edut mena leh – dela ketiv beh "veneelam"; hacha name la ketiv beh "veneelam"!
Amar lehu rav huna: umay chucha? dilma mezid delav kashshogeg befikkadon, mimmeila rabbi shimon gamar la!
Vehayeynu chucha – addegamar la mimmeila, nigmar la meedut!
Mistabbera mimmeila hava leh lemelaf, shekken meila mimmeila.
Adderabba – meedut hava leh lemelaf, shekken "techeta" mittecheta"!
Mistabbera mimmeila hava leh lemelaf, shekken meila; bakkol; nehene; bekavua; chomesh; veasham.
Adderabba – meedut hava leh lemelaf, shekken chet; hedyot; bishvua; taveh vechafreh; veoin"! hanach nefishin.
Ella may chucha?

Ki ata rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua mibbe rav, amri: hayeynu chucha – mikkede rabbi shimon gezera shava gemir, lema leh defarech: ma lefikkadon shekken lo asa bo musheba kannishba, mezid kashshogeg?
Umay chucha? dilma ki parech – mikkamme detekum leh gezera shava; batar dekama leh gezera shava la parech!
Vela?! vehaamar lehu rava bar ittay lerabbanan: man tana shevuat happikkadon lo nittan zedonah lechappara – rabbi shimon hi!
Dilma mezid kashshogeg parech, degamar la mimmeila, dehanach nefishin; aval musheba kannishba la parech.
Vetehdar edut vetigmer la mippikkadon, mezid delav kashshogeg – ma pikkadon, shogeg in mezid la; af edut, shogeg in mezid la – ki hechi deyalef pikkadon mimmeila!

a: Lehachi katva rachamana leedut gabbe shevuat bittuy vegabbe tumeat mikdash vekadashav – divchullan neemar bahen "venelam", vechan lo neemar bahen "venelam"; lechayyev al hammezid kashshogeg.
Mishna "mashbia ani alechem, im lo tavou uteiduni sheamar ish peloni litten li matayim zuz velo natan" – hare ellu peturim, sheen chayyayvin ella al teviat mamon kefikkadon.
"Mashbia ani alechem keshettedu li edut shettavou uteiduni" – hare ellu peturim, mippene shekkadma shevua leedut.
Amad bevet hakkeneset veamar: "mashbia ani alechem, sheim attem yodin li edut shettavou uteiduni" – hare ellu peturin, ad sheyyehe mitkavven lahem.

Amar lishnayim: "mashbia ani alechem ish peloni ufeloni, sheim attem yodin li edut shettavou uteiduni", "shevua sheen anu yodin lach edut"; vehem yodin lo edut ed mippi ed, o shehaya echad mehen karov o pasul – hare ellu peturin.
Shillach beyad avdo, o sheamar lahen hannitba: "mashbia ani alechem, sheim attem yodin lo edut shettavou uteiduhu" – hare ellu peturin, ad sheyyishmeu mippi hattovea.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "mashbiani alechem im lo tavou uteiduni sheamar ish peloni litten li matayim zuz velo natan" – yachol yehu chayyayvin? talmud lomar: "techeta"–"techeta" ligzera shava.
Neemar kan "techeta", veneemar lehallan "techeta"; ma lehallan bitviat mamon – veyesh lo, af kan bitviat mamon – veyesh lo.
"Mashbia ani alechem keshettedu li edut" kulei.

Tanu rabbanan: "mashbia ani alechem keshettedu li edut shettavou uteiduni" – yachol yehu chayyayvin? talmud lomar: "veshama kol ala vehu ed o raa o yada" – mi shekkadma edut lishvua, velo shekkadma shevua leedut.
Amad bevet hakkeneset veamar "mashbiani alechem". amar shemuel: afillu edav benehen.
Peshita! la tzericha, dekae illavayhu; mahu detema: keman deamar lehu dame, ka mashma lan.

Tanya name hachi: raa sia shel bene adam omdin, veedav benehen, veamar lahen: "mashbiani alechem im attem yodin li edut shettavou uteiduni" – yachol yehu chayyayvin? talmud lomar: "vehu ed" – vahare lo yiched edav. yachol afillu amar "kol haomdin kan"? talmud lomar: "vehu ed" – vahare yiched edav.

Amar lishnayim: "mashbia ani alechem". tanu rabbanan, amar lishnayim: "mashbia ani alechem peloni ufeloni, im attem yodin li edut shettavou uteiduni"; vehen yodin lo edut ed mippi ed, o shehaya echad mehen karov o pasul – yachol yehu chayyayvin? talmud lomar: "im lo yaggid venasa avono" – biruyin lehaggada hakkatuv medabber.

Shillach beyad avdo vechulei. tanu rabbanan: shillach beyad avdo, o sheamar lahen hannitba: "mashbiani alechem sheim attem yodin lo edut shettavou uteiduhu" – yachol yehu chayyayvin? talmud lomar: "im lo yaggid venasa avono".
May talmuda? amar rabbi elazar: "im lo yaggid" ketiv; im lo lo yaggid – venasa avono, veim leacher lo yaggid – patur.
Mishna "mashbiani (ani) alechem"; "metzavve ani alechem"; "oserchem ani" – hare ellu chayyayvin.
"Bashshamayim uvaaretz" – hare ellu peturin. "bealef dalet"; "beyod he"; "beshadday"; "bitzvaot"; "bechannun verachum"; "beerech appayim"; "berav chesed"; uvechol hakkinnuyin – hare ellu chayyayvin.
Hamekallel bechullan – chayyayv; divre rabbi meir. vachachamim potrin.
Hamekallel aviv veimmo bechullan – chayyayv; divre rabbi meir. vachachamim potrin.
Hamekallel atzmo vachavero bechullan – over belo taase. "yakkecha Adonai elohim", vechen "yakkecha elohim" – zo hi ala hakketuva battora.
"Al yakkecha", vivarechcha" veyetiv lach" – rabbi meir mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.

Gemara "mashbiani alechem" – may kaamar? amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: "mashbia ani alechem bishvua haamura battora"; "metzavve ani alechem betzavvava haamura battora"; "oserchem ani beissur haamur battora".
Amar leh abbaye, ella ha detane rabbi chiyyay: "kovelchem ani" – hare ellu chayyayvin; kovel beorayyta mi ketiv?!
Ella amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: "mashbia ani alechem bishvua"; "metzavve ani alechem bishvua"; "oserchem ani bishvua"; "kovelchem ani bishvua".
"Bealef dalet"; "beyod he"; "beshadday"; "bitzvaot"; "bechannun verachum"; "beerech appayim"; "berav chesed".

Lememra dechannun verachum shemot ninhu?! ureminhi: yesh shemot shennimchakin, veyesh shemot sheen nimchakin – ellu hen shemot sheen nimchakin: kegon "el", "elohecha", "elohim", "elohechem", "ehye asher ehye", "alef dalet" veyod he", "shadday", "tzevaot" – hare ellu en nimchakin.
Aval "haggadol", "haggibbor", "hannora", "haaddir" vehechazak" vehaammitz", "haizzuz", "channun verachum", "erech appayim" verav chesed" – hare ellu nimchakin.
Amar abbaye: matnitin "bemi shehu channun"
b: "Bemi shehu rachum" kaamar.
Amar leh rava: i hachi, "bashshamayim uvaaretz" name – "bemi shehashshamayim vehaaretz shello" kaamar!

Hachi hasheta?! hatam, kevan delekka midde acharina deikkeri rachum vechannun – vadday "bemi shehu channun", vadday "bemi shehu rachum" kaamar. hacha, kevan deikka shamayim vaaretz – "bashshamayim uvaaretz" kaamar.
Tanu rabbanan: katav alef lamed meelohim", "yah" meAdonai" – hare ze eno nimchak. shin dalet mishshadday", alef dalet meadonay", tzadi bet mitztzevaot" – hare ze nimchak.

Rabbi yose omer: "tzevaot" kullo nimchak – shello nikra tzevaot ella al shem yisrael, shenneemar: "vehotzeti et tzivotay et ammi vene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim". amar shemuel: en halacha kerabbi yose.

Tanu rabbanan: kol hattafel lashshem, ben millefanav uven milleacharav – hare ze nimchak. lefanav ketzad? "laAdonai" – 30 nimchak; "baAdonai" – 2 nimchak; "vaAdonai" – 6 nimchak; "meAdonai" – 40 nimchak; "sheAdonai" – 300 nimchak; "haAdonai" – Adonai nimchak; "kayya" – 20 nimchak.
Leacharav ketzad? "elohenu" – nu nimchak, "elohehem" – hem nimchak, "elohechem" – chem nimchak. acherim omrim: leacharav eno nimchak, shekkevar kiddesho hashshem. amar rav huna: halacha kaacherim.
(Avraham, delatya, lenavot, begivat binyamin, shelomo, daniel – siman)
Kol shemot haamurim battora beavraham – kodesh; chutz mizze shehu chol – shenneemar: "vayyomar, adonay im na matzati chen beenecha".

Chanina ben achi rabbi yehoshua verabbi elazar ben azarya mishshum rabbi elazar hammodai amru: af ze kodesh. keman azla ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav: gedola hachenasat orchin yoter mehakebalat pene shechina – keman? keoto hazzug.

Kol shemot haamurim belot – chol; chutz mizze shehu kodesh – shenneemar: "vayyomer lot alehem, al na adonay, hinne na matza avdecha chen beenecha vegomer" – mi sheyyesh beyado lehamit ulehachayot, ze hakkadosh baruch hu.

Kol shemot haamurim benavot – kodesh, bemicha – chol. rabbi eliezer omer: benavot – kodesh, bemicha – yesh mehen chol veyesh mehen kodesh. alef lamed – chol, yod he – kodesh; chutz mizze, shealef lamed vehu kodesh: "kol yeme heyot bet haelohim beshilo".
Kol shemot haamurim begivat binyamin – rabbi eliezer omer: chol, rabbi yehoshua omer: kodesh.
Amar lo rabbi eliezer: vechi mavtiach veeno ose?!

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: ma shehivtiach asa; vehem lo bichanu im lintzoach im linnatzeach. baacharona shebbichanu – hiskimu al yadan, shenneemar: "ufinchas ben elazar ben aharon (hakkohen) omed lefanav bayyamim hahem lemor, haosif od latzet lammilchama im [bene] vinyamin achi im echdal vegomer".

Kol "shelomo" haamurin beshir hashshirim – kodesh, shir lemi shehashshalom shello; chutz mizze: "karmi shelli lefanay haelef lecha shelomo" – shelomo ledideh, "umatayim lenotrim et piryo" – rabbanan. veyesh omrim, af ze chol: "hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim".

Af ze – vela mibbee haych?! ella ha deamar shemuel: malchuta dekatla chad mishshitta bealma la miansha, shenneemar: "karmi shelli lefanay haelef lecha shelomo" – lemalchuta dirkia, "umatayim lenotrim et piryo" – lemalchuta deara; shemuel la ketanna kamma vela keyesh omrim?!
Ella hachi kaamar, veyesh omrim: ze – kodesh; veze hu chol – demittato. ushemuel deamar keyesh omrim.
Kol malchayya haamurim bedaniyyel – chol; chutz mizze shehu kodesh: "ant malka [melech] malchayya di elah shemayya, malchuta chisna vetokpa vikara yehav lach".

Veyesh omrim: af ze kodesh – shenneemar: "mari chelma lesanach ufishre learach" – leman kaamar? i salka datach linvuchad netztzar kaamar leh, sanoteh may ninhu – yisrael; melat ka layet lehu leyisrael?!
Vetanna kamma savar: sone yisrael ikka, sone goyim lekka?!
Uvechol kinnuyin – hare ellu chayyayvin kulei.

Ureminhi: "yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua" – ma talmud lomar? vahalo kevar neemar: "vehishbia hakkohen et haishsha bishvuat haala"! lefi shenneemar: "veshama kol ala" – neemar kan "ala" veneemar lehallan "ala"; ma lehallan shevua, af kan shevua; ma lehallan bashshem, af kan bashshem.

Amar abbaye: la kashya; ha rabbi chanina bar idi, ha rabbanan. detanya, rabbi chanina bar idi omer: hoil veamra tora "hishshava" veal tishshava", "kallel" veal tekallel" – ma "hishshava" bashshem, af "lo tishshava" bashshem; ma "kallel" bashshem, af "lo tekallel" bashshem.
Verabbanan, i gemiri gezera shava – nive shem hameyuchad! i la gemiri gezera shava – "ala" dishvua hi mena lehu?
Nafka lehu middetanya: "ala" – en "ala" ella leshon shevua, vechen hu omer: "vehishbia hakkohen et haishsha bishvuat haala".
Hatam "shevuat haala" ketiv! hachi kaamar: "ala" – en "ala" ella bishvua, vechen hu omer: "vehishbia hakkohen et haishsha bishvuat haala".

a: Uminnayin laasot ala sheen immah shevua keala sheyyesh immah shevua, ushevua sheen immah ala kishvua sheyyesh immah ala? talmud lomar: "veshama kol ala" – veshama ala, veshama kol.
Amar rabbi avahu: minnayin leala" shehi shevua? shenneemar: "vayyave oto beala vegomer"; uchetiv: "vegam bammelech nevuchadnetztzar marad asher hishbio belohim".
Tana: "arur" – bo nidduy, bo kelala, bo shevua.
Bo nidduy – dichtiv: "oru meroz amar malach Adonai, oru aror yoshveha", veamar ulla: bearba mea shippure shammeteh barak lemeroz.
Bo kelala – dichtiv: "veelle yaamdu al hakkelala", uchetiv: "arur haish asher yaase fesel vegomer".
Bo shevua – dichtiv: "vayyashba yehoshua baet hahi lemor, arur haish lifne Adonai vegomer". vedilma tarte avad lehu – ashbeinhu velayytinho?

Ella mehacha: "veish yisrael niggas bayyom hahu, vayyoel shaul et haam lemor, arur haish asher yochal vegomer", uchetiv: "vihonatan lo shama behashebia aviv et haam". vedilma hacha name tarte avad lehu – ashbeinhu velayytinho?
Mi ketiv "vearur"?! hasheta deatet lehachi, hatam name la ketiv "vearur".
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: "amen" – bo shevua, bo kabbalat devarim, bo haamanat devarim.
Bo shevua – dichtiv: "veamra haishsha amen amen".
Bo kabbalat devarim – dichtiv: "arur asher lo yakim et divre hattora hazzot laasot otam, veamar kol haam amen".
Bo haamanat devarim – dichtiv: "vayyomer yirmeya [hannavi] (el chananyahu), amen ken yaase Adonai, yakem Adonai et devarecha".

Amar rabbi elazar: "lav" – shevua, "hen" – shevua. bishlama "lav" shevua – dichtiv: "velo yihye od hammayim lemabbul", uchetiv: "ki me noach zot li asher nishbati". ella "hen" shevua – mena lan? sevara hu – middelav" shevua, "hen" name shevua.

Amar rava: vehu deamar "lav" "lav" tere zimne, vehu deamar "hen" "hen" tere zimne; dichtiv: "velo yikkaret kol basar od mimme hammabbul", "velo yihye od hammayim lemabbul"; umiddelav" tere zimne, "hen" name tere zimne.
Hamekallel bechullan – chayyayv, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim potrin.

Tanu rabbanan: "ish [ish] ki yekallel elohav venasa cheto" – ma talmud lomar? vahalo kevar neemar: "venokev shem Adonai mot yumat"! yachol lo yehe chayyayv ella al shem hameyuchad bilvad, minnayin lerabbot et hakkinnuyin? talmud lomar: "ish ish ki yekallel elohav vegomer" – mikkol makom. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: al shem meyuchad bemita, veal hakkinnuyin beazhara.
Vehamekallel aviv veimmo vechulei. man chachamim?
Rabbi menachem bar yose. detanya: rabbi menachem bar yose omer: "benokvo shem yumat" – ma talmud lomar "shem"? limmed al hamekallel aviv veimmo, sheeno chayyayv ad sheyyekallelem bashshem.
Vehamekallel atzmo vachavero kulei. amar rabbi yannay: vedivre hakkol.

Atzmo – dichtiv: "rak hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha meod" – kidrabbi avin amar rabbi ila, deamar: kol makom shenneemar "hishshamer", "pen" veal" – eno ella lo taase. vachavero – dichtiv: "lo tekallel cheresh".
"Yakkecha Adonai elohim", vechen "yakkecha elohim" – zo hi ala hakketuva battora. yatev rav kahana kammeh derav yehuda, veyatev vekaamar ha matnitin keditnan. amar leh: kanne.
Yatev hahu merabbanan kammeh derav kahana, veyatev vekaamar: "gam el yittotzcha lanetzach, yachtecha veyissachacha meohel, veshereshcha meeretz chayyim sela". amar leh: kanne.
Tarte lema li? mahu detema: hane mille matnitin, aval bikrae ema la mechannenan; ka mashma lan.
"Al yakkecha", vivarechcha", veyetiv lach" – rabbi meir mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.
Veha let leh lerabbi meir mikkelal lav atta shomea hen! efoch.
Ki ata rabbi yitzchak, tena keditnan. amar rav yosef: hasheta daanan tenan hachi, vechi ata rabbi yitzchak tane hachi, shema minna davka tenan.
Ella kashya! ki let leh – bemamona; aval beissura it leh.
Hare sota – deissura hu,
Veamar rabbi tanchum bar chachinay: "hinnaki" ketiv; tama dichtiv "hinnaki", ha lav hachi – mikkelal lav atta shomea hen la amrinan!
b: Ella efoch – afillu beissura let leh.
Matkef leh ravina: uveissura let leh?! ella meatta, shetuye yayin uferue rosh – divmita; hachi name delet leh lerabbi meir?! vehatnan: ellu shebbemita – shetuye yayin uferue rosh!
Ella leolam tefoch; ki let leh – bemamona, beissura it leh; veshane sota deissura deit beh mamona hu.
Hadaran alach shevuat haedut
Mishna shevuat happikkadon noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokim uvikrovim, bichsherim uvifsulim;
Bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din – mippi atzmo; umippi acherim – eno chayyayv ad sheyyichperennu bevet din. divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: ben mippi atzmo ben mippi acherim – kevan shekkafar bo chayyayv.
Vechayyayv al zedon hashshevua, veal shiggatah im zedon happikkadon; veeno chayyayv al shiggatah geredta. uma chayyayv al zedonah? asham bechesef shekalim.
Shevuat happikkadon ketzad? amar lo: "ten li pikdoni sheyyesh li beyadcha", "shevua sheen lecha beyadi"; o sheamar lo: "en lecha beyadi", "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – hare ze chayyayv.
Hishbia alav chamesh peamim, ben bifne bet din uven shello bifne bet din, vechafar – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. amar rabbi shimon: ma taam? mippene sheyyachol lachazor ulehodot.

Hayu chamishsha tovim oto – amru lo: "ten lanu pikkadon sheyyesh lanu beyadcha"; "shevua sheen lachem beyadi" – eno chayyayv ella achat. "shevua sheen lecha beyadi, velo lecha velo lach" – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. rabbi eliezer omer: ad sheyyomar shevua baacharona. rabbi shimon omer: ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad.

"Ten li pikkadon utesumet yad gazel vaaveda sheyyesh li beyadcha"; "shevua sheen lecha beyadi" – eno chayyayv ella achat, "shevua sheen lecha beyadi pikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda" – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.

"Ten li chittin useorin vechussemin sheyyesh li beyadcha"; "shevua sheen lecha beyadi" – eno chayyayv ella achat, "shevua sheen lecha beyadi chittin useorin vechussemin" – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. rabbi meir omer: afillu amar "chitta useora vechussemet" – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.

"Anasta ufittita et bitti", vehu omer: "lo anasti velo pittiti"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar: "amen" – chayyayv. rabbi shimon poter, sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo. amru lo: af al pi sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo, meshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo.
"Ganavta et shori", vehu omer "lo ganavti"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – chayyayv. "ganavti, aval lo tavachti velo macharti"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – patur.
"Hemit shorcha et shori", vehu omer "lo hemit"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – chayyayv. "hemit shorcha et avdi", vehu omer "lo hemit"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – patur.

Amar lo: "chavalta bi veasita bi chabbura", vehu omer: "lo chavalti velo asiti becha chabbura"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – chayyayv. amar lo avdo: "hippalta et shinni vesimmita et eni", vehu omer: "lo hippalti velo simmiti"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – patur.
Ze hakkelal: kol hameshallem al pi atzmo – chayyayv, vesheeno meshallem al pi atzmo – patur.
